When I applied in 2004, there were 6 positions and 600 applications. Working at Kellogg’s promised to be a lifelong career. A good-paying job that afforded me the opportunity to become a homeowner, let my wife stay home with the kids, live decently, retire some day, and hopefully live happily ever after. But over the years, wages became a two-tier system. New workers were being paid less than workers had made decades earlier. Cost of living adjustments weren’t keeping up anywhere near inflation. Retirement and health insurance plans had been gutted. It just wasn’t right. They were making record profits – and doing it off the backs of workers. So in October 2021, we walked out. And as president of our local union, I led the strike. = It was the first time many of us had ever walked a picket line. It was cold, but we were determined to hold our lines even through the dead of the winter if we had to. Every worker knew we were a part of something bigger than ourselves. Friend,
I'm usually not one to get overly emotional, but thinking back to
the day I met my husband brings back so many emotions.

By now,
you've probably heard of my husband Sam Brown's incredible story.

I first
met Sam in the burn unit. He'd just returned from Afghanistan
where he and his soldiers were ambushed by the Taliban.

A
roadside bomb exploded under his vehicle and left him permanently
disfigured.

Today, I
stand by his side as he runs for the U.S. Senate in the biggest
race on the map - the race that could ultimately determine the
Senate majority.

But what
you may not know is that Sam completely turned MY life around.

You see,
the week leading up to meeting Sam was filled with some of my
darkest days. But the day I met Sam in the burn unit was the
greatest day of my life.

My
husband inspired me to return to my Faith in God.

Throughout his lengthy recovery - he NEVER gave up hope.

But what
set Sam apart was that, even when things were at their darkest,
his Faith in God was stronger than ever.

Truly, in
the darkest days of his recovery, he was a light to everyone
around him.

Every day
for months, he fought with every fiber of his being to recover so
he could return to serve with his men in Afghanistan.

That's
why I know Sam will never stop fighting when it matters most for
our country.

Sam will
never lack the will, the hope, or the strength to keep going. But
we need YOUR help to have the resources keep our operation
moving.

Today,
Sam is working with every fiber of his being to win this Senate
race. But the reality is that Chuck Schumer and the far-left
Democrats know just how important this race is.

My
husband was given a new life by God that day on the battlefield.
I was given a new life the day I met him.

Friend,
It could only be divine intervention that brought Sam and I
together.

I am
confident that we were ultimately led here, to this new
battlefield to save America.

Even in
his toughest tests, Sam has proven to be the leader we need in
the Senate.

I don't
know where I'd be without Sam today, but I'm so grateful that God
put him in my life.

Would you
please consider supporting Sam today to help us secure America's
future for our children and yours?

Sincerely,

Amy Brown

Sam Brown
is a retired member of the U.S. Army. Use of military rank, job
titles, and photographs in uniform does not imply endorsement of
the United States Army or the Department of Defense.

# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1999%2E135344%2En0mtVQ)

Friends --
Yesterday, Donald Trump rallied supporters alongside Mike Rogers in Kent County before heading to Warren, Michigan for a town hall.
On stage, Rogers and Trump sang each other’s praises. Trump said he “picked” Mike Rogers as the Senate candidate. He endorsed him in the primary because he knows that Rogers will be a rubber stamp for his far-right agenda. In addition, Trump used his town hall to advance lies about the integrity of our elections, saying the only way he loses if there is cheating. As someone who barricaded herself in her office on January 6th, this kind of language should be disqualifying.
**On top of all of that, he made it clear that Michigan is his TOP priority in his campaign, saying: “If we win Michigan, we win it all.”**
The reality is that if Trump loses Michigan, he will almost certainly lose the White House — and Republicans will lose the Senate. And the better I do in my race, the better Kamala Harris likely does in the state as well.
That’s why Republicans are throwing everything they can at Michigan: Outside groups are spending more than $30 million in TV ads attacking me and propping up Mike Rogers – with likely more on the way.
The latest polls show our state is virtually tied — for both the presidential and the Senate race. Political forecaster Nate Silver’s recently published analysis said not only that Michigan is a pure toss up, but also that there may be no state more important than Michigan in this election.
The only thing we know for certain is that this race will come down to the wire and could go either way on Election Day. And with voters in Michigan already casting their ballots, we can’t waste a single moment in this race. Every voter we reach, every door we knock, every ad we air, and yes every dollar we raise, can be the difference in a race like ours.
But we are not powerless in this campaign.

name: Douglas Carswell
subject: The public supports parent power
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/msla-11573144?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
| Dear Friend, **There’s a real chance we could see school choice in Mississippi. **

Thanks to our new school funding formula, each public school student in our state now has a personalized budget designed to meet their individual education needs.

**Why not let families take their personalized budget to a school of their choice? **

That is precisely what families can now do in three of our neighboring states, Arkansas, Louisiana and Alabama. So, why not Mississippi?

**One of the obstacles standing in the way of school choice in Mississippi has been the ridiculously misnamed _“Parent’s” Campaign_. **For years, the _“Parent’s” Campaign_ has lobbied lawmakers to prevent parent power.
---
|
---
_Opposing parent power since 2006_
| Nancy Loome, who runs the “Parent’s” Campaign, was at it again recently. **In “The Lie of School Choice”, she recycled various tired myths and misinformation about what parent power really means.**

**__Myth One__** was the claim that school choice takes money away from public schools. It doesn’t.

**Now that every child in the public school system in our state has a dedicated budget, we are proposing that they be allowed to take their share of state funds to a _public_ school of their choice. **

Any family that prefers not to take up their child’s place within the public school system, because they opt to go private or to home school instead, would receive a tax credit to off-set the fact they are currently paying for their child’s education twice.

It is factually wrong to claim that any of this would divert public money away from public schools.
---
|
---
| **__Myth Two__** is that school choice means some hidden agenda to deny admissions.

**Under our proposals, each school district would have the power to define capacity.** This is precisely in line with what Lieutenant Governor, Delbert Hosemann, has said publicly he would support.

Schools must have strong safeguards that allow them to reject applications from those out of district with a history of disciplinary problems.

**__Myth Three__** is that school choice is somehow unfair because it doesn’t provide transportaion costs.

We don’t propose paying for transportation costs for a very good reason. **The point of school choice is to raise standards in failing districts, not to facilitate the transfer of kids from failing districts into good performing districts. **

**__Myth Four__** is that school choice is all about benefiting private schools, rather than raising standards in public ones. Again, this is false.

Private schools in our state are doing fine. Since 2021, the number of kids enrolled in private schools in our state rose from 49,000 to 56,000. It is public schools, where enrolment fell 12 percent over the past decade, where school choice in most needed.

**We want school choice in Mississippi not because we are against public schools, but because we support them and want them to thrive.**
---
|
---
| **__Myth Five__** is the claim that “Mississippi’s public schools are delivering impressive results”. Some districts achieve good results. Most do not.

One in four students in the public school system in our state routinely skips school. **Four in ten fourth graders lack the basic reading standard required to read this sentence.** Eight in ten eighth graders are not proficient in math.

Mississippi’s accountability system may indeed only rate a handful of school districts as D or F. That says more about the inadequacies of the accountability system than it does about the quality of education.

**If public schools were doing so well, why are the number of kids enrolled in public schools in decline?**

If school choice is unnecessary because standards really are so excellent, as Nancy and co claim, why do they fear the consequences of giving parents more power?

Finally forced to come out and say in public they’ve been whispering to lawmakers at the Capitol for years, the anti-school choice campaigners’ arguments don’t add up. **Exposed to scrutiny, the anti-school choice lobby has all the credibility of the Flat Earth Society.**

Actual parents across Mississippi, as opposed to campaigners claiming to speak for parents, know this.

**At his excellent Policy Summit this week, House Speaker Jason White, shared with the 500+ attendees the results of his recent polling.** Not only was there massive support for tax reform, but the slide on school choice showed overwhelming support for parent power.

**73 percent of White voters and 65 percent of Black voters support allowing parents a more active role in choosing their children’s education. 84 percent of Republicans, 57 percent of Democrats and 70 percent of Independents agreed. **Here is an issue that Mississippi can unite behind.

Time may be up for those that have spent the past decade quietly killing off anything that looks like parent power in various legislative committees. Actual parents aren’t on your side, and the anti-parent power lobby may be about to find that out.

Have an awesome weekend!

**Here is a look at some of our Georgia candidates:**

**✅ Danielle Bell for Georgia State House of Representatives District 44:** Danielle is a military wife, the mother of young children, a social worker, and a small business owner. She plans to promote equality in education, healthcare, and economic opportunities. She told us she’d start by advocating for policies that can address the maternal healthcare crisis in Georgia and restore abortion access. **She is running against a man who has been in this seat for nearly 30 years – since 1995 – who voted in support of the 6-week abortion ban in Georgia.**

**✅ Susie Greenberg for Georgia State House of Representatives District 53:** Susie has a 40-year history of fighting for women's healthcare and reproductive rights. Beginning in college in the 1980s, she was a patient escort for a reproductive healthcare clinic and worked through the decades as a strong advocate, including serving as a board member of Planned Parenthood Southeast and NCJW Atlanta. name: Rob Mercuri
subject: New Economic Ad & Early Voting Update
body:
Only 38 days to go until Election Day

|
---
Friend, We have just 38 days to go until Election Day, and with each day that passes, our campaign continues reaching new heights while sharing our common sense message. **Lowering Inflation** Our new ad, which we are sharing with you today, highlights my focus on lowering inflation, modernizing our electric grid, and bringing back family-sustaining jobs to western Pennsylvania. In Congress, actions speak louder than words - I have fought and will continue to fight for policies that improve the lives in our region - you can check it out here:

[](https://robmercuri.nationbuilder.com/r?u=q31vKxd331IPg-GLhqL4qookt7kvNJLsDz9b7Q4m3BQ&e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=09_27_24_email_to_supporters&n=1) **Our Vision Contrasts with a Failed Vision** While my vision prioritizes fiscal responsibility and prosperity for all, Kamala Harris’ plan puts the radical left’s agenda front and center. During a campaign stop in Pittsburgh this week, Harris made it clear that her “opportunity economy” was nothing different than what we have experienced the last 3 1⁄2 years - more spending, higher inflation, and less opportunity for all. Western Pennsylvanians cannot afford another four years of the same - we have to make clear to Kamala Harris and Chris Deluzio that their failed economic plans are bad news for hard-working families. **Early Voting Begins Soon** Our campaign has made a concerted effort to ensure people know that voting is possible through several different channels \- including by mail. Court cases surrounding early voting have caused delays, but according to the latest reports, early voting in Allegheny County will begin soon, with [news coming out this week that mail-in ballots are going to be reaching mailboxes as early as this weekend. ](https://robmercuri.nationbuilder.com/r?u=dWzKuY5kvD1R0VhHLB-lr20YeVKaKoPswgJLiu8d4hzAi7UCNj_u5XPvySca1_ZQ-GtwElgM1KC4r9Q-7QhUfTuBepd-wRv-GeDfELMk1mP5JpEo7YCZAyMKgFD26DMGXCftg3DCTLvZvVckFxGgoA&e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=09_27_24_email_to_supporters&n=2) In Beaver County, the most recent signs point to their mail-in ballots going out in early October. [You can find more information here](https://robmercuri.nationbuilder.com/r?u=FXosIKQOQsuzFxurCEZw68mzGQMDymYMIvqNZoS5Ut0LaJH-MLrcLFt1qhECzGmS7-5i5phZqwZkwAV_9imHqd9FQyDR-EVgVkms9TwVbXw&e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=09_27_24_email_to_supporters&n=3). It is vitally important that we encourage our family, friends, and neighbors to vote by mail this election year - by banking your vote early, it ensures your vote is counted, prevents a scenario in which you miss out on voting, and ends the non-stop political mail ending up in your mailbox! If you are interested, I strongly encourage you to visit [https://www.pa.gov/en/agencies/vote/voter-support/mail-in-and-absentee-ballot.html](https://robmercuri.nationbuilder.com/r?u=lvC0zySgANn09obiz0UGcERadoCJMnx4lvjd6hWYm23JJIaJVq4OiF7UA8BAGDB6hkHTIN7hHJuZw7gKG8dpLZfHE6IeSMQloGoFzyqHMSr-6YeNgLKe-Bqs-QQZ6msG&e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=09_27_24_email_to_supporters&n=4) to learn more about how to request a mail-in ballot, and how to return it prior to Election Day. **End of September Fundraising Deadline** We only have 2 days remaining until our end of September fundraising deadline. Can you [chip in $5, $10, $25, $50, $100?](https://robmercuri.nationbuilder.com/r?u=flBDtqPbDiWRlxBXWwXH-QmKshK3no_4UipNukJhZ99RDhsiM_AR4u1oRxwyteWjGKMDFyYj98-cMSyXV0pVxw&e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=09_27_24_email_to_supporters&n=5) By donating today, your donation will help to continue spreading our message on the airwaves, plus building up our grassroots even more! Our campaign is in the driver’s seat, and your financial support today will help us flip PA-17 and return common sense leadership to Washington. I am grateful for [your continued support](https://robmercuri.nationbuilder.com/r?u=flBDtqPbDiWRlxBXWwXH-QmKshK3no_4UipNukJhZ99RDhsiM_AR4u1oRxwyteWjGKMDFyYj98-cMSyXV0pVxw&e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=09_27_24_email_to_supporters&n=6), and I look forward to winning with you this November! Leading us forward, Rob Mercuri[](https://robmercuri.nationbuilder.com/?e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=09_27_24_email_to_supporters&n=7) | [](https://robmercuri.nationbuilder.com/r?u=flBDtqPbDiWRlxBXWwXH-QmKshK3no_4UipNukJhZ99RDhsiM_AR4u1oRxwyteWjGKMDFyYj98-cMSyXV0pVxw&e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=09_27_24_email_to_supporters&n=8 "DONATE TODAY") [DONATE TODAY](https://robmercuri.nationbuilder.com/r?u=flBDtqPbDiWRlxBXWwXH-QmKshK3no_4UipNukJhZ99RDhsiM_AR4u1oRxwyteWjGKMDFyYj98-cMSyXV0pVxw&e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=09_27_24_email_to_supporters&n=8)

Peter, I write to you all the time about how our corrupt government often hides invasive policies that most New Jersey voters

| Peter, I write to you all the time about how our corrupt government often hides invasive policies that most New Jersey voters wouldn’t dream of supporting under seemingly harmless names. Well, the latest example is the [“Freedom to Read” Act](https://xtz223.keap-link010.com/v2/click/6831883b03e61711aa543738fc585ac5/eJyNkMsOgjAQRf9l1oRCwUfYITFKUBdG1wZhgtVamjIYH-HfrY-40sT1nHtu7tyAUOWK0hIiONOV8wAcMFgILVBRUivKi-eV90I_8B2QQh0mpm41RLev4Q_wTA39oQN00WiR1TJOsnQx2czSRWZJnRvb8adn4H0843mczqDrforxKGh8su4GIjItPhaVwq6itZGW3xHpJmJMt1tX7SVWblWf2EhI2TDu8ZDFQc_zWBCG_c3ad6eruZXmWqMq3x_J8PJSd3eGi2Zs), which just passed in the state house early this summer. Of course, no one objects to the freedom of speech and everyone wants to support children reading. But that isn’t what this bill does. It would allow for school libraries to curate woke, sexually-explicit materials by giving librarians immunity from civil and criminal liabilities for “good faith actions.” It also gives school boards total control to adopt “model policies” established by a state senate committee. Meanwhile, all the controversial material stays in schools while the policies are being reviewed. So, as you can see, this bill isn’t about free speech. It’s about going around taxpayers to indoctrinate children in public schools. **There’s still a chance to stop this bill from becoming law!** The Senate Education Committee is holding a hearing on this bill (Bill A3446) this coming Monday, September 30. The senate has every intention of ramming this bill through before taxpayers know what’s in it. We need all common sense voters to speak out against this bill. The American Founders thought that the
proper role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution.

But progressives see the Court
differently. They want activist judges to legislate from the
bench.

Do you agree that the role of the
Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution as it is written and
NOT to make laws or advance a particular policy agenda?

YES

NO

Even worse, progressives dismayed by
recent Supreme Court decisions want to "pack" the bench with
additional justices to advance a preferred policy agenda.

As Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D-Mass.) put

a broken institution, Congress must expand the Supreme Court by
four or more seats."

That is why I'm reaching out to you
today...

What is your opinion about the Supreme

Please share your thoughts with me
using the College's National Survey on the United States Supreme

* We trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have to lock our doors at night.

We've forged bold bipartisan partnerships to pass commonsense legislation. We've safeguarded the rights of our veterans and LGBTQ people. And every day, we continue to strive for a better world for each and every one of our neighbors. But still, let me be clear: The threat from Republicans like Scott Perry and Donald Trump is really serious. Already in Pennsylvania, Republicans have: ❌ Made MASSIVE voter registration gains, meaning that Democrats have only a small lead – the smallest in decades – in voter registration in Pennsylvania. ❌ Spent millions to secure their hold in the Commonwealth, because they know the road to the White House runs right through this, our battleground, state. ❌ Climbed in the polls, meaning that margins to Democratic victories across key districts – and the presidency – are now razor-thin. I'm running for reelection to both put a stop to the rising tide of the far right AND to continue securing meaningful victories for you and your family – from securing our fundamental reproductive rights to fixing our broken immigration system. But that can only happen if I can reach more voters to keep this critical House seat blue and get back to work in November. No other presidential campaign in U.S. history has encountered as many hurdles to ballot access as ours. This demonstrates how vital your support is as we turn our focus to securing a place on the ballot in **Pennsylvania** , a critical battleground state.

#
There are 38 days left until we have the chance to make history on November 5th.
In New York, we’re hitting the ground running to deliver a victory for Democrats, and for a state amendment that would preserve reproductive freedom and protect our LGBTQ+ neighbors. **But we need your help**.

name: Eric H. Holder, Jr.
subject: When I travel our country, I see folks taking ownership of our democracy
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY THE NATIONAL REDISTRICTING ACTION FUND
body:
People are donating their time — and, if they have it, their money, too.
|
---

Peter,
With just about five weeks to go until November’s election, it’s an exciting time to be on the road. Daily, I am reminded of the urgency of our work.
I see, and am inspired by, folks participating in and fighting for our democracy. They’re going door-to-door organizing their neighbors, registering them to vote, and making plans to bring them to the polls on Election Day. They’re pressing their local candidates, demanding they commit to being fair maps champions. They’re donating their time — and, if they can spare it, their money, too.
**We are in control of our own destiny. We are the stewards of our democracy. And we have it in our power to shape where the journey goes next — as long as we put in the work.**
All On The Line is dedicating time and resources toward mobilizing people to get involved in critical elections up and down the ballot and to take democracy into their own hands.
Support from grassroots activists like you enables us to stand unwavering against assaults on democracy and amplify our determination for fairness across the nation.
[**Peter******,** I am personally asking you to take ownership of our democracy and make a donation of any amount to ensure that we are a strong grassroots team for years to come. clean_body: People are donating their time — and, if they have it, their money, too. | Peter, With just about five weeks to go until November’s election, it’s an exciting time to be on the road. This happened last night:
I was backstage at the [TuckerCarlson](https://open.substack.com/users/236367471-tuckercarlson?utm_source=mentions) Live Tour... was having a blast meeting new friends (and some old ones too), and then [@RealAlexJones](https://substack.com/redirect/4ee7da9d-e88b-41eb-92b5-ebb3288b10db?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) walked around the corner and just paused, leaned against the wall and said "hello."
A new friend was standing there with me and filmed this interaction.
In the past, when describing someone who's been tagged by the "powers-that-be" as an undesirable or someone the rest of us should avoid at all cost...I would say with a smirk, "He or she is the Alex Jones of Pennsylvania," for instance.
But one day after saying this, I paused long enough to ask myself "Why am I not supposed to like him?" I don't follow him. I don't know him. I don't watch Infowars. At the time, I didn't know much about him... except that I wasn't supposed to like him.
The ultimate mind control is when you don't like someone, because you've been instructed not to like them, and you don't even know why you don't like them. Crazy, I know. But we're all doing it.
These are real people, with real lives and real families, and some of them have been destroyed... and most of us have fed into their feeding frenzy.
I found [@RealAlexJones](https://substack.com/redirect/4ee7da9d-e88b-41eb-92b5-ebb3288b10db?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to be kind. Surprisingly, calm energy. But he's no beta male...I could sense that right away.
Last night, Alex Jones started going on and on, while on stage with Tucker, about spider goats. Yeah you read that right. Spider goats... and then, as he was speaking, he said, "Go look it up." I did. Right there on the spot. OMG! Spider goats are real. Who knew!
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9492bf20-41f2-4d82-a0b9-00dc577b9161?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Perhaps if we listened more to people... even if they don't say it the way we would say it, we would all be much better off, and our country wouldn't be drowning right now.

Hi Peter,

Hello. Ken Burns here.
I've spent five decades making films that tell the stories of America’s greatest challenges — from the Civil War to the Dust Bowl, from the Second World War to the Vietnam War.
In each of these historic moments, we were challenged to live up to the essential promise of our nation: preserving a democratic system of government that respects the rights and addresses the needs of all its citizens.
Today, challenges to our republic are rampant once again. The democratic values that make up the very fabric of our nation are under assault and at risk of unraveling. It’s never been more important to safeguard our fragile democracy: as Benjamin Franklin so wisely put it, "A Republic, if you can keep it."
But this election is not just about keeping Donald Trump out. It's about coming together to protect our shared American values and restoring integrity to our government. That's why electing leaders to the Senate that we can be proud of is so important – and why we have to help Elissa Slotkin hold Michigan's Senate seat for Democrats this fall.
There is also a personal connection in this race for me. Like Elissa, I grew up in Michigan. And she’s a student of history, which I so appreciate in an elected official.
I'd really like to make sure she wins her Senate race this November. So I am asking:
Can I count on you to contribute $5, $20 or whatever feels right to you today directly to Tim Kaine's Senate campaign in Virginia and Elissa Slotkin's Senate campaign in Michigan? I would not be reaching out were it not so important. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-slotkin]

There’s no doubt about it — in just 2 days, we’ll close the books on our final quarterly filing deadline of the election season, and Marsha Blackburn will rake in a ton of cash from her corporate interest buddies. That’s the story when your opponent has spent years cozying up to the gun lobby, pharmaceutical companies, and corporate PACs. But here’s the thing — while Marsha might be swimming in corporate cash, we’ve got something she’ll never have: **_people power._** **We’ve seen it time and time again — grassroots campaigns like ours, powered by small-dollar donors like YOU, can take on even the most well-funded politicians and win.** But we can only pull it off if we hit our $350,000 goal before the deadline — and right now, we’re falling short. Both of these Congresswomen know a thing or two about beating the odds.

Delia, a housing advocate and former state representative, defeated a
crowded field to become the first Latina Congresswoman from the Midwest.
Her mother was pregnant with Delia when she crossed the Rio Grande.

Summer, an organizer and state representative, defeated millions of
outside spending from AIPAC to become the first Black woman elected to
Congress in Pennsylvania.

The path to Congress was anything but easy for Delia and Summer – it still
isn’t. As Teen Vogue notes, “Reps. Lee and Ramirez are navigating an
institution that wasn't built for people like them.”

The profile shines a light on how both of these young, working-class,
progressive women of color were figuring out how to afford rent in D.C.
after leaving their full-time jobs to serve in Congress.

Now, they’re roommates in a three-bedroom house sharing the experience of
serving the people, sometimes facing uncomfortable conversations with
colleagues who have no idea what it’s like to live paycheck to paycheck.

| | Peter, there’s no doubt about it: **Black voters are going to have a major impact on this election.**

From Georgia to Michigan to Nevada, Black voters in swing states could decide who ends up in the White House and which party controls Congress.

But here’s the thing: Communities of color are the most susceptible to efforts to suppress the vote. That’s why it’s so important for us to do everything we can to make sure Black voters get to the polls, are able to cast their ballots, and have their votes counted.

**[_Will you help The Collective PAC provide 5,000 Black voters with a ride to the polls? | **ICYMI: Tony Wied Shows WI-08 Voters He’s the Right Choice**
De Pere, WI – Small businessman and Republican Congressional nominee Tony Wied faced off against his Democratic opponent in a debate last night and clearly demonstrated why he is the right choice to represent WI-08.
On the issues most important to Wisconsin voters, such as the economy, the southern border, and reckless government spending, Tony Wied laid out a clear vision to tackle these problems in Washington.
“The inflation we are seeing is a direct result of the reckless spending of the Biden-Harris Administration and I am the only candidate that will go to Washington to put a stop to it,” said Wied.
Tony focused on the issues facing WI-08 voters rather than getting swept up in personal attacks from his opponent.
Wied went on to say, “The big difference between me and my opponent is she attacks people and I attack problems.”

Friend, Michigan’s 12th congressional district is home to one of the largest and most vibrant Lebanese communities in the United States. Right now, my neighbors are grieving the Israeli government’s horrific escalations that have endangered and slaughtered their loved ones in recent weeks. **Israel’s indiscriminate bombing campaign in Lebanon has so far displaced 500,000 people, maimed and wounded thousands of people, and killed more than 600 people—including more than 50 children.** Israel’s leaders have admitted that continued U.S. military assistance is the only way they can sustain their attacks. After facing no red line in Gaza or the West Bank over the past year, Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu is now expanding his violent campaign to Lebanon. [**Sign to demand President Biden end U.S. weapons to Israel now. It’s time for our country to stop arming and funding war crimes.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38bacrXqz-CH_FIlv0-54amMMH6jRAbDa2EaVhLmyFMpkhuTy95DsswGDlKFFCp79BtLmPOdB73t4iIggpdLfSmAKrkYpQ-v7V6HZNmJVbNCheN613_W779YhR4jwh4CSXz5Mq0_6W-rfyLEBwhcv5VZnaDi4GWCC-Lp8RNnMrjMMepv2Kc6y64wLixe0cDnfui27oW1XDPz6QZQn6Tjmef6W70DXbzO5ev8lgG1IX09GI5nzWdApJqVap6632iuOrzN5pSM0D9R2VHJBNIbmEMlqi-cqvB2DAX3nsFh5C7LRuBRuyBQr2Rsvc0SNSPnzY/4a5/kpGuK_aLTiyLXafn6RrL_Q/h1/h001.xoCc4NBzWYVt-jwNJuoC-VIgUG13l8gQUeZlDuxJFfw) This September, our communities also marked the anniversary of brutal Israel-backed massacres in Lebanon that killed thousands of Palestinian refugees in 1982. After that year’s invasion of Lebanon, Israel occupied southern Lebanon for nearly 20 years. Israel’s government continues to commit clear violations of international law. Last week, **124 countries in the United Nations voted** to support a resolution demanding Israel’s military end its illegal occupation and withdraw from Palestine. **The resolution also called on countries to comply with international humanitarian law and stop sending weapons to Israel.** The U.S. voted against that resolution and continues to provide about 70% of Israel’s weapons. The next biggest arms supplier to Israel is Germany, which has stopped approving new weapons exports because of legal cases charging Germany with violating international law through weapons provided to Israel. The UK has stopped sending some weapons because of similar concerns. The U.S. must follow. The U.S. military just sent more troops to the region, and the Israeli army chief has warned about the possibility of a ground invasion in Lebanon. Deploying more U.S. troops and more U.S. bombs will only lead to more suffering and carnage. The Biden-Harris administration can and must stop the bloodshed. [**Please add your name to demand President Biden implement an immediate arms embargo to end the slaughter of civilians and de-escalate the risk of a wider regional war.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38bacrXqz-CH_FIlv0-54amMMH6jRAbDa2EaVhLmyFMpkhuTy95DsswGDlKFFCp79BtLmPOdB73t4iIggpdLfSmzPdA-rUPP6B84quf8ywpY73O2ZVB3RK9xWPrMTtuo7e8Ed-PSS2PBlGLomSNnu8uuue6DEzJ4xBgWwL1irwu7g9bnX8-HBq_qFg6LP3ZT1Y9wwptmzqHUPzooqQGBuRsy8bpei0n_TThCC3bpip0aiWdRc9WzetkLySPBgzqKEyUZrGp1OZ-66nIL_ddUHyd8HXtRqDasvVzjChEY-3J3V2UZ9_4FhcslBwlH05uhCI/4a5/kpGuK_aLTiyLXafn6RrL_Q/h2/h001.5KW6f8MtXkIeWq0TqA5DuihQAwr61MLUo-qPL6E6PvU) Thank you for continuing to raise your voice against the atrocities and dehumanization of the past year. In this heartbreaking time, I’m sending you love and strength. -Rashida \---------- Forwarded message ---------

About 500,000 people have been forcibly displaced already, and thousands have been wounded. The Biden-Harris administration can stop the bloodshed, rather than continuing to allow the Israeli government to operate with impunity as they carry out war crimes. This week, ProPublica released an investigation showing that **U.S. Secretary of State Blinken knew that Israel’s government deliberately blocked humanitarian aid to Gaza, but lied about it to Congress.**
Experts from multiple state agencies shared abundant evidence with Blinken. They called for a pause on arms transfers to Israel in order to comply with U.S. law—which mandates cutting off weapons to governments that block U.S. humanitarian assistance.
The U.S. government should have stopped arming Israel’s genocide of Palestinians then. In the months since Blinken’s statement to Congress in May, Israel’s government has continued to devastate and ethnically cleanse Gaza, and recently launched the largest invasion of the West Bank in decades—with fighter jets, drones, armored vehicles, and ground forces.
Now, Israel’s government is expanding its violence in Lebanon, threatening a ground invasion. **Instead of deploying more U.S. troops to the region, our government must stop military assistance to Israel.**
[**Add your name to demand President Biden cut off weapons to Israel now.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38bacrXqz-CH_FIlv0-54amMMH6jRAbDa2EaVhLmyFMpkhuTy95DsswGDlKFFCp79BtLmPOdB73t4iIggpdLfSmM3KD-gl2QjvLEIO8R5559xhTzWxREiuHosd33TkiMMGyNHlFeHIv_GmVC9bRYxoyoTElNjJeQQKpJO9Wg5FPw1XHcJb2eNo79XDrQqsz2_l0Kr-jylCOJKfOjDnNA4ZqTfuHiOliAs9fiKwAJhmL9dXElaJhgdYaJkfGC_1WSydb_ACA4JcogFE33Zu5RBsMDrth1RJ2EEFSQDx3TcB-xx44mfmQomt7cwBvXr5Cbu8/4a5/kpGuK_aLTiyLXafn6RrL_Q/h5/h001.WBzulnfSbEg4T64hbCp1a01GE7m2BEDdLk7FNc-4PbY)
Thank you for continuing to speak up about the horrors and dehumanization our government is enabling with our tax dollars. Our communities have already been in so much pain over the last year, and my heart goes out to everyone grieving.

---|---|---
We need to have a serious talk about Proposition 1...
If you haven't heard about it yet, let me tell you: _**this is the most dangerous political trick Idaho has faced in decades.**_ It's a ticking time bomb specifically designed to destroy our conservative values and flip Idaho blue. Because what Prop 1 does is enact a top-four "jungle primary" combined with somethign called "ranked-choice voting (RCV)."
To put it plainly: it's a scam- a rigged system designed to confuse voters, split the conservative vote, and hand power over to liberals and liberal Republicans.
Let's get specific about what this could mean for District 13 in Nampa, Idaho (my district). I've been honored to serve you, winning two primaries against liberal Republican Jeff Agenbroad. In 2022, I beat him with 57.6% of the vote, pulling in 3,162 votes to his 2,330.
_That was[a 15% margin](https://substack.com/redirect/6de35b4d-97ff-41f5-9006-e8b4880b7995?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--a clear, solid victory for conservative values:_
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4b0d884c-2262-4078-8239-22a59ea1d5a7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
In 2024, it was the same story...
Despite blasting me with 9 months of non-stop TV attack ads, spewing lies, and blowing over $300,000 to try and take me down, Agenbroad lost--again. I crushed him with 55.6% of the vote, earning 2,695 votes to his 2,154.
Once again, Nampa sent a loud, unmistakable message...

_**District 13 stands for bold, uncompromising conservative values, and no amount of liberal money or smear campaigns will change that:**_
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/eec2de73-9119-4e65-a788-455f873e6a63?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Now let's talk about Sarah Butler, my Democrat challenger in the upcoming general election.
She's not even close to being a threat in a fair election--she squeaked by with just 492 votes in her uncontested primary this year. Like Kamala Harris, she was the only Democrat in the race, and yet she could barely get 500 Democrats to show up for her in a district with tens of thousands of voters.
Sarah Butler's 492 votes in her uncontested primary represent around 7% of the nearly Democrats in the district.
_**That's a dismal turnout, showing just how little enthusiasm there is for her campaign:**_
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3abfa0e5-6ca1-4b07-96f4-ad41cd5b34b6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
As it stand snow, the numbers don't lie: Butler doesn't have a chance when only 30% of Nampa votes Democrat.
In fact, if you look at the 2020 general election for District 13, Melissa Sue Robinson, the Democrat, only managed 6,290 votes, which was a weak 29.2% of the vote. Meanwhile, Agenbroad cruised to victory with 70.7% or 15,222 votes.
_**The truth is, the Democrat base in this district is limited and weak.**_
In every election in the history of District 13, it's always been a clear Republican win. And it doesn't even matter who the Republican is, because even when you get someone like Jeff Agenbroad (who's basically a Democrat in disguise) Republicans still win:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3de3f258-dfc8-47ad-ac08-093e0c08ffb5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
_**That 's why Proposition 1 is such a danger... **_
It's an attempt to change the rules because they know they can't win a straight-up fight. Under this new system, we'd all be thrown into a jungle primary, and the top four vote-getters--no matter what party--would move forward to the general election. So instead of a head-to-head contest, we'll end up with four candidates on the ballot in November, and that's where things get messy.
Here's the worst part: ranked-choice voting (RCV). It sounds harmless on the surface, but it's built to manipulate the outcome.
## **What District 13 Could Look Like if Prop 1 Passes**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/814169e0-e672-428d-968d-c3bdfb439306?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Here's how voting and elections "work" under the proposed system.
When you vote, you don't just vote for your top choice. You have to rank all the candidates. So, let's say I'm your first choice (and I hope I am!). Maybe you leave Agenbroad off your ballot entirely, because he doesn't represent your conservative values. And of course, Butler is your last choice.
But here's where things get tricky!
Butler, the Democrat, would almost certainly be eliminated first. She's only got her small base of 492 primary voters and whatever Democrat voters she can round up--(like the 6,290 voters Robinson got in 2020). That's not enough to win outright, so she gets knocked out of the race.
_**But under RCV, her votes don 't disappear--they get redistributed to the second-choice candidate her supporters picked. And guess who that is? Agenbroad. **_
So, suddenly, Butler's liberal Democrat voters are giving their second-choice votes to Agenbroad, the liberal Republican!
Agenbroad is exactly the kind of politician Democrats would support as their fallback option. He's a soft-on-values, big-spending Republican who'd cozy up to them in a heartbeat. _So while I may win the first round decisively, RCV lets the second-place loser crawl back into the race by scooping up Democrat second-choice votes._ Even though you, the voters, made it clear you wanted a true conservative to represent you, the system would be rigged to help the moderate, squishy Republican pull ahead in the final rounds.
By the time they're done doing their "serious math," I could lose the election--despite winning the most first-choice votes.
**That 's the whole point of ranked-choice voting: it gives losers a second chance and lets them sneak into office by riding on the backs of second-choice and third-choice votes.**
If you think this sounds far-fetched, just look at Alaska...
That's a 60% Republican state, but thanks to ranked-choice voting, _Sarah Palin --who led in the first round--lost to a Democrat in a special election._ The same trick they pulled in Alaska is exactly what they're trying to pull off here in Idaho.
Don't think for a second that this couldn't happen in District 13.
Because the people pushing Proposition 1 are the same ones pushing a left-wing agenda here in Idaho. The folks backing Boise Pride Fest, the Democrats, and liberals in both parties who despise our values--they're all on board with this because they know it's their best shot at taking power without having to actually win over the majority of voters.
_**They need Prop 1 to split the conservative vote and give them a backdoor to control Idaho.**_
If this passes, Idaho won't be Idaho anymore.
We'll be stuck in a future where liberals and RINOs are working hand-in-hand to undermine everything that makes this state great. People like Sarah Butler--who shouldn't even be close to power--will be just one step away from winning, all because they split our conservative vote.
And let me be clear: _**Agenbroad won 't protect Idaho's values. **_He's already proven that he's willing to sell out for the middle ground. If he gets propped up by Butler's voters in a ranked-choice election, he'll keep doing it.
We can't let that happen.
We have to stop this before it starts.
## This is Basically, D.E.I. for Elections
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f8793413-557d-4088-804e-1227e3776ad5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Except instead of forcing woke leftist talking points down your throat, this will be shoved into Idaho's elections. And just like DEI,**Ranked-Choice Voting (RCV)** and what they're calling **" open primaries"** are designed to confuse, divide, and weaken us from the inside out.
Just like how DEI pushes identity politics over merit, this system pushes "fairness" over the simple principle of the majority deciding. It's a feel-good scam, built to make losers feel like winners and to give radicals a backdoor into power.
_And the people pushing it know exactly what they 're doing._

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

But the reality is that Chuck Schumer and the far-left Democrats know just how important this race is. My husband was given a new life by God that day on the battlefield. I was given a new life the day I met him. Friend, It could only be divine intervention that brought Sam and I together. I am confident that we were ultimately led here, to this new battlefield to save America. Even in his toughest tests, Sam has proven to be the leader we need in the Senate. I hope you're having a great day so far. I'm reaching out to share something important with you...something that could expand your horizons. I'm talking about studying American history! As Hillsdale College professor Wilfred McClay explains in our online course ["The Great American Story: A Land of Hope,"](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=7ea8086ddbf14be0ba0c0ec799dde5fe&_e=HKr1Vq0L8EPp3gsiPFAJ-lEKfUx9aKqH7_ctPY8WPkQi5hhhYCjjle2-AkVe7-crd4OeNInkLkcHaGdUgBp6jg64KYgKtBEYA1Xcu-Ja3L31NbIeQ91IMvKP8ZrRrp4gpZ8pJ31TNzRq9kIlExCUHWE1Xyvo7Y4WIRs_tlJ20dpwT3xvnrQulsNr5qz_BjOTSSDNx_qtMoGYUdonSRNSzqJwDu7-ugGIHPYqO6GQ8k2PC6A3yjZQhKxVte4yNzXzenAFxpgarFCMXCNK0hhlGQfAxk4QJouwHnIilK9liI4_A_DPIr9z1_uXpFdFzu0cHra2IL-odZAeshGLs63kQDQNTnQ8dcVIKlYP1indjMXeM28llnea1D_l90b1QQh9huPF5n02G1zI-XT5X4Fl6PZsvCzmO_-GY9iVWgeAPgo%3D) studying history can broaden your perspective and help you understand different ways of living. Compare that to _The New York Times '_ "1619 Project," now a multi-part series streaming online. The "1619 Project" locates the founding of America in 1619, the year the first slave arrived on our shores, rather than in 1776, when the **Declaration of Independence declared that all men are created equal with unalienable God-given rights**. According to the "1619 Project," the key to understanding America is not freedom but slavery--and the project's main goal is to broadcast this false teaching into every home, including yours. We must counter this false and dishonest historical narrative with the truth. **That 's why we've turned our online course, ["The Great American Story: A Land of Hope,"](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=7ea8086ddbf14be0ba0c0ec799dde5fe&_e=HKr1Vq0L8EPp3gsiPFAJ-lEKfUx9aKqH7_ctPY8WPkQi5hhhYCjjle2-AkVe7-crd4OeNInkLkcHaGdUgBp6jg64KYgKtBEYA1Xcu-Ja3L31NbIeQ91IMvKP8ZrRrp4gpZ8pJ31TNzRq9kIlExCUHWE1Xyvo7Y4WIRs_tlJ20dpwT3xvnrQulsNr5qz_BjOTSSDNx_qtMoGYUdonSRNSzqJwDu7-ugGIHPYqO6GQ8k2PC6A3yjZQhKxVte4yNzXzenAFxpgarFCMXCNK0hhlGT-yQ08f8_Jxto4ncY49dSxFv6kb9CxjsxkqwaoIUWBAPR1GvIig0ESCuWg97ce-EYRW70dzIyT4byiASc9KeHcBGlQKSAG2lzQJFj1n2oWtMMwh12dXRgXhZaVgQvY3jsUUUBlK_6WPbHvqmJgjZmQ%3D) into a DVD set, and I'd like you to have a copy.** **" The Great American Story: A Land of Hope"** presents a full, unbiased account of America's past. Hello,
After the 2022 election, I had a hard decision to make.
When I ran against Lauren Boebert in 2022, I knew we could win. No one believed me – not the Democratic party, not the Republican party, and certainly none of the political pundits.
Ultimately, though, after the recount, I lost to Lauren Boebert by just 546 votes. It was the closest race in the entire country.
We were outspent heavily by Boebert and her allies. And the attacks and the vicious lies they told about me were really hard on my family – especially my two teenage children.
After we came so close to winning against Boebert, everyone expected me to run again in 2024. It seemed like a no-brainer. But it wasn’t an easy decision to put my family through what I knew was going to be an even nastier race than the last.
I spent a lot of time reaching out to supporters and donors like you, listening and getting their advice. And everyone promised me: They’d have my back. So I took a leap of faith.
Now, with Lauren Boebert having run off scared, this seat is going to be much harder to win. The Super PACs are attacking me and the smear campaign is beginning. I need your help if I’m going to have the resources it takes to finish the job and win this critical House seat.
I made the decision to run again because I knew I could count on people like you to help me win, so it would mean so much to me if you could chip in to my campaign today:

According to Google, sharing the stories of a former Palestinian refugee, an Arab Muslim born in Israel, and brave U.S. Navy SEALs who witnessed the horrors of Muslim extremism constitutes “hate speech.” **Dear Infidels** went viral on social media, reaching millions of people! Like clockwork, Big Tech reared its ugly head to shut us down and suppress our reach. We immediately jumped into action and began sounding the alarm. Thanks to our dedicated followers and supporters, Big Tech did NOT win, and their Soviet-style censorship tactics were thwarted. After major outcry from our supporters and several media outlets, Google put the PragerU app back on the Google Play Store...for now. Unfortunately, we know this won’t be the last time we are targeted by Big Tech giants. It is imperative that we keep fighting for our freedoms. **[**At PragerU, we always fight back, but we need your help.**](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=c269f7c3affc4ab0969679471b36a0bf&_e=7d3DV_9K-cyEwb2bNTvgT7Vrf-jRVjo87eZAfc2y6N15ZP3A-bOGrBayDcA6u7y1RAq-Bnl36Ww4MSKiTVDghqFLigxv2YqI2EJmZkDNizurwgRPOoCuFKcuxH9s1ywfNjBJhGyHYO1T5RkPr27Rt6bXrWwk084x7yPRvr_Z7jXik89UIaBHqznfoeqNdOoiFrzG7xMxh7L30GrwsIQDQkxaKUeShyNZBPUncB9sdRWNsIKgHUgGHvSz1zgx-fQihK6udzWLxpvAK4H7VS8CFg%3D%3D)** This is a David vs. Goliath battle. Trump International Hotel & Tower Chicago (Trump Organization)
By Illinois Review

President Donald Trump made a quick swing through Chicago on Friday night – staying at his luxury 5-star hotel before departing for a rally in Wisconsin on Saturday as polls show Trump widening his lead in key swing state races just 37 days before November’s election.

Earlier on Friday, Trump met with Ukranian President Volodmyr Zelenskyy at Trump Tower in New York City before heading to Michigan where he delivered remarks at an afternoon rally and appeared at a town hall in the evening. Trump Force One was spotted landing at Chicago’s O’Hare Airport at 10:15 pm local time on Friday. Once in the city, the large motorcade with a heavy police presence made its way on Lower Wacker Drive and arrived at Trump International Hotel & Tower underground.

Chicago, the host city for the Democratic National Convention in August, has dominated the headlines as over 30,000 migrants – many from Venezuela, have arrived in the sanctuary city since 2022 – angering local residents as Democratic leaders have allocated over $400 million to house, clothe and feed the migrants as local residents plead for help and assistance.
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/09/president-trump-stays-at-chicago-hotel-ahead-of-wi-rally-as-new-polls-show-a-kamala-kollapse-in-key-swing-state-races.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=59865d1f01-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
Violent Venezuelan gangs are now terrorizing sanctuary city neighborhoods including in Chicago – taking over neighborhoods and housing units, and many predict that a street war will erupt with international gangs who were allowed to enter the U.S. through the Biden-Harris open border policies. Local gangs are said to be reaching their breaking point.

Since 2022, there has been an 11,000 percent increase in arrests of Venezuelans in Chicago. A string of burglaries are also popping up in the Chicagoland suburbs as migrants freely roam the streets.

body:
Are we the only campaign you get email updates from?
#
Hey Derek, quick question for you: Are we the only campaign you get email updates from? We’re betting the answer is no.
In fact, you probably get a _lot_ of emails from a _lot_ of different folks. And a lot of those other emails probably don’t treat you with the respect you deserve.
**They may even treat you more like an ATM than a valued supporter. 🙄**
The reality is every campaign, including ours, has to raise money ([**so please, pitch in to help us reach our end-of-quarter goal if you can**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240928?refcode=em20240928&amount=5&refcode2=9429_434096_lr-4PV&akid=9429%2E434096%2Elr-4PV)). But here are just a few examples of the kind of scammy, dishonest tactics you’ll never see from John:
_**“DONATE NOW OR WE ARE DOOMED!”**_
_**“7X MATCH ACTIVE!”**_
_**“WARNING: FINAL NOTICE ENCLOSED”**_
We don’t engage in that kind of BS because we know you’re _not_ an ATM. **You’re a real person** , with a real job, a real life, and real concerns. And you deserve to be treated like one too. Especially by those who are asking you to elect them to public office.
So while we do count on grassroots donations to keep this campaign running, we’ll always be up front and honest about what we’re asking for and why.
**Here’s why we’re asking today: Our end-of-quarter fundraising deadline is on Monday, and we still need some help to reach our goal. Reaching these goals is REALLY important if we want to keep PA 🔵.**
[**So if you can, please pitch in $5 to help us reach our end-of-quarter goal. We absolutely need your help, but we will _never_ try and trick you into donating.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240928?refcode=em20240928&amount=5&refcode2=9429_434096_lr-4PV&akid=9429%2E434096%2Elr-4PV)
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240928?amount=5&refcode=em20240928-9429&refcode2=9429_434096_lr-4PV&akid=9429%2E434096%2Elr-4PV)**
Thanks,
Team Fetterman

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-emails?refcode=em20240928-9429-footer&t=1&refcode2=9429_434096_lr-4PV&akid=9429%2E434096%2Elr-4PV)**

| | Dear Fellow American,

I'm glad you opened my email today! I have something urgent to ask you that will shape the future of our families, communities, and country.

[**Will you take our National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory (CRT)?**](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=b620e961bbab4a16a3017ba8ae2e726c&_e=QShpR-hSn4gveveeT7IP2YNzJ80GqTJ0p9cYtIVPqf7jmBf9eYHbllt6xmdcR3Sv9Okz4EOYo8LaBJ6EjmVq0cC9_DFPmx_nME86nuaGh9jCuXuh7ngu8xlK_4j4kK30TrQifC4Vwevi6Ym6-awy6M6iJM6N5gpk-ZIpMPU3WeCgr_R9Mz8ewi3ah0MwevNNVmPLY4CdLTUPx3UaFN4WMz3XYPGnqHnAVaJ6SC2-ZoIvBr6Rn_QLGQNSCMFdUBzO3zbCYfHj-ym0zWa0m4XZuMRSts3T9FoiaDC9qv7gdrTAI7dLWUSPVZ-AAkqRCWQNJSFGL0vFKZk-ski71YkGFeXfhK6BIljXkSATUcNhUUpNdRJEfDb72gThQUU4hoP-)

Your participation will help us understand and address many Americans' concerns about CRT's influence on our society.

This survey will only take just a few minutes.

But in those few minutes, you'll help us gather important insights to defend America's founding principles of liberty...

...and ensure a bright future for our children and grandchildren.

**You can share your thoughts on CRT in the National Opinion Survey on Critical Race Theory Survey here:**

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/crt-survey/**](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=b620e961bbab4a16a3017ba8ae2e726c&_e=QShpR-hSn4gveveeT7IP2YNzJ80GqTJ0p9cYtIVPqf7jmBf9eYHbllt6xmdcR3Sv9Okz4EOYo8LaBJ6EjmVq0cC9_DFPmx_nME86nuaGh9jCuXuh7ngu8xlK_4j4kK30TrQifC4Vwevi6Ym6-awy6M6iJM6N5gpk-ZIpMPU3WeCgr_R9Mz8ewi3ah0MwevNNVmPLY4CdLTUPx3UaFN4WM0qg5udBt4op4-4qCwkK5vKI3yjhF34NlgzATCQcGVeG7DBmYVZOHAocFvmIBMBf5GpggVkGZnt_KeKXTc5L2lqhxHaigPf1KW9x0mDRZjGCeyLmVttqBNi_Fe1vsRZIOeE045TpWwpJ62NGfisXD9HzoChiQ5SRrZ_aT8KAbhF0)

Sharing your opinion is an important way you'll combat the spread of CRT in our schools and workplaces. Together, we can preserve the constitutional and free-enterprise principles that made our nation so great and so free.

Thanks in advance! I look forward to seeing your response.

Bill Gray, '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement
Hillsdale College

Dear Peter,
My name is Jeff Crosby. **While you may not know me, you might know my dad, Lt. Col. Harry “Croz” Crosby, who was portrayed on _Masters of the Air._**
My dad enlisted after Pearl Harbor, leaving his studies and family, to protect America and the world from the evils of dictatorship and imperialism. With the 100th Bombardment Group in the US Army Air Forces, he flew over 30 bombing missions over Europe and led thousands of heavy bombers as the lead navigator of the 100th bomb group.
I often think about what my dad would say about Donald Trump and all he represents. But I don’t have to wonder or guess. My dad would sign up again to do everything possible to defeat Trump at the ballot box in November.
Just the other day, Donald Trump declared that he would give migrants “serial numbers” to better organize their detention in camps, and deportation. These are the same people that Trump compared to an infestation. This is the kind of language and twisted plans we all know from our history books. My wife and I have taken a Haitian asylum seeking family into our home, and I can assure you that this is no "invasion." Just hard working people fleeing violence and seeking a better life.

subject: 🚩Help after 'Helene' 🚩 then 🌎LET'S GO GREEN! 🌎
body:
American ingenuity and common sense can confront this crisis, create more jobs, and help defend Mother Earth for future generations. | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/dd8290979f0c/help-after-helene-then-lets-go-green?e=5d7e9a146c)

|

|
## Help after ‘Helene’ ... then “let’s go green!”

Before I appeal to our shared values on climate change, we mustn’t overlook the death, despair and devastation our neighbors in nearby states have experienced this week in the wake of another powerful and deadly hurricane. If it’s in your heart to help, might I suggest options for disaster relief donation(s)?
[**DIRECT RELIEF**](https://malhyman.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=98998055a4d4c8cdda41af3ea&id=0b75196bd5&e=5d7e9a146c) : a humanitarian aid organization, active in all 50 states and more than 80 countries, with a mission to improve the health and lives of people affected by poverty or emergencies – without regard to politics, religion, or ability to pay - has made available (so far) $74 million in medicine and supplies to local and regional health organizations impacted. [**AMERICARES:**](https://malhyman.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=98998055a4d4c8cdda41af3ea&id=08efe82914&e=5d7e9a146c) is deploying emergency response experts to Florida to support health needs in the affected areas and has offered assistance 360 clinic partners across the affected region.[**AMERICAN RED CROSS:**](https://malhyman.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=98998055a4d4c8cdda41af3ea&id=e6d66f0b16&e=5d7e9a146c)**** volunteers and staff work to deliver vital services – from providing relief and support to those in crisis, to helping you be prepared to respond in emergencies.
---
|
---
| What we’ve witnessed just this week is another in a long list of “wake up calls” Mother Earth keeps sending our way. Does she have our attention this time?
Earlier this month,[ on the subject of immigration](https://malhyman.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=98998055a4d4c8cdda41af3ea&id=abe1b9f54f&e=5d7e9a146c), I said “it’s time to do what Americans used to do best: tackle tough problems with policies that strengthen America.”
The Pentagon in 2002 declared climate change a greater threat to our national security than terrorism. The increased number and intensity of droughts, wildfires, hurricanes, floods and famines lead to political instability, wars and mass migrations. Just imagine the challenges of developing countries responding to hurricanes like Helene. Our civilization has become a force of nature, which threatens our security.
Under the leadership of Joe Biden and Kamala Harris, America invested an unprecedented half of a trillion dollars in sustainable energy. This will create more than a million good jobs - many of them already here in our part of South Carolina - while strengthening our competitiveness in this rapidly growing sector. “Green energy” creates more jobs in the short and the long term – and more security with it. I see this as common sense for the common good.
[_**Hey, before I talk about another big green energy jobs boost in our district, can you chip in a few dollars to help me unseat MAGA Republican Russell Fry and flip the House?**_](https://malhyman.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=98998055a4d4c8cdda41af3ea&id=f1db22c322&e=5d7e9a146c)
Developing sustainable energy, to not only meet our needs at home and on the job, but also the movement of goods and services - was once a pipe dream; that conservatives once mocked
Yet Wednesday [I joined business and civic leaders](https://malhyman.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=98998055a4d4c8cdda41af3ea&id=ea7e5b3d57&e=5d7e9a146c) \- some of them Republican - at the Florence Chamber of Commerce luncheon, to celebrate the news of [AESC’s electric vehicle (EV) battery plant expansion](https://malhyman.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=98998055a4d4c8cdda41af3ea&id=3bd1a37ab0&e=5d7e9a146c) in South Carolina’s 7th Congressional district. Another 1000-plus jobs, bringing the total at that plant to 2700 in Florence County.
Not California or Vermont; _South Carolina!_
---
[](https://malhyman.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=98998055a4d4c8cdda41af3ea&id=9c95b01338&e=5d7e9a146c)
| Dr. Robert Engelhorn, BMW president & CEO of manufacturing, with Mal Hyman, Wednesday at the Florence Chamber of Commerce Luncheon
---
| President Biden and Congressional Democrats passed the Inflation Reduction Act of 2022, with credits and incentives for green energy initiatives. Individuals, families, towns, cities, counties, low income communities and businesses of all sizes have benefited. An estimated $15 billion of investment in clean power generation and storage has been earmarked [specifically for South Carolina](https://malhyman.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=98998055a4d4c8cdda41af3ea&id=19d0a06dcb&e=5d7e9a146c) through 2030.
There’s a clear choice for us this November: the party of MAGA –which denies climate change is real vs. the party that doesn’t see red states or blue states; just the “United States.” You see, Joe Biden and Kamala Harris have presided over record growth in manufacturing spurred by green energy - in states red and blue.
You bet I celebrated with BMW’s President and CEO of manufacturing, Dr. Robert Engelhorn, earlier this week. We’re both excited to see the investments made in the Inflation Reduction Act paying off for domestic electric vehicle manufacturing and the jobs it’s brought, and will continue to bring, to South Carolina.
American ingenuity and common sense can confront this crisis, create more jobs, and help defend Mother Earth for future generations. The world is watching. We need a House of Representatives that will fight for this future. Our grassroots campaign needs your support; so join the fight!
Learn more about my views on [climate change](https://malhyman.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=98998055a4d4c8cdda41af3ea&id=e6b1d39a2e&e=5d7e9a146c), [job growth](https://malhyman.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=98998055a4d4c8cdda41af3ea&id=70627ecacd&e=5d7e9a146c), my [opposition to offshore drilling (and fracking, too)](https://malhyman.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=98998055a4d4c8cdda41af3ea&id=2a3eceb86d&e=5d7e9a146c) and more [here](https://malhyman.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=98998055a4d4c8cdda41af3ea&id=70a1ed6f38&e=5d7e9a146c).

Hi there, it's Brian King's team here. This Public Lands Day is being marred by what Gov. Cox is calling a "landmark lawsuit" by the State of Utah against the federal government for control of public lands—**we're calling it what it really is, conniving and deceitful.** **This lawsuit is nothing more than an attempt at taking public lands**** _away_****from the public to line the pockets of a select few.** [**Before we continue, we have to let you know that we have $7,290 left to raise to reach our last End of Quarter Fundraising Goal. Can you please make a grassroots contribution today and help our campaign go into October strong—for the better? >>**](https://king4ut.us/l/FXzfz4OsjTkm)
---
[ PITCH IN ](https://king4ut.us/l/Ldfo8tHiJjlX)
---
This lawsuit is **_deceitful_** in the way that Gov. Cox has framed it as a "historic" attempt to reclaim land from the Bureau of Land Management (BLM) and the federal government. Right now, these public lands are in public hands—**not the state's.** Their hunger for power knows no bounds, and with the approval of Gov. Cox, this Republican supermajority has only increased their attempts to steal power from the people in any way they can, be it through Amendment D or this lawsuit. **_A lawsuit that is conniving because by taking control over public lands from the BLM, they will then be able to be sold to private companies for harmful development and resource extraction._** On top of that, Utah taxpayers are also footing the bill on a nationwide ad campaign for the lawsuit, which Republican leaders hope will increase the likelihood that the U.S. Supreme Court will take up the case. **_Honestly, we're not surprised, but we are disappointed._****** [**Let this be the start of something actually historic in Utah. Let's outraise Gov. Cox's campaign by crushing our last End of Quarter Fundraising Goal. As of the writing of this email, we're $7,290 away from reaching it. The change to bring accountability and common sense back to our government starts here. It starts with Brian, Rebekah, and you. Can you chip in today?**](https://king4ut.us/l/jSXf5dD0TIu7)
---
[ DONATE TODAY ](https://king4ut.us/l/ZQqFPz2rN4Rp)
---
Thank you and happy Public Lands Day, Team Brian King

| | | Brian, the fifth of five boys, was born in Salt Lake City.

[](https://king4ut.us/l/oajMIlkCIXG0)

Returning to Utah after his mission for the LDS church in St. Louis, Missouri, Brian’s decision to follow in his family's legal footsteps unfolded organically. Three out of five brothers became lawyers, and Brian decided to become a trial lawyer representing individuals who have been harmed by insurers’ wrongful denial of claims.

The intertwining of family, career, and public service defines Brian's narrative. As an LDS Bishop in the mid-1990s, he embraced connecting with people during vulnerable moments. Political service became a natural extension of Brian's commitment to community. Elected to the State Legislature in 2008, he later assumed the role of House Minority Leader from 2015 to 2023. In navigating the complexities of legislation, Brian learned the art of thoughtful disagreement for the better—a principle he carried into the legislative sphere from his personal and professional life.

In 2022, Brian's life took a new turn when he married Ann Silverberg Williamson, adding twin daughters and a son to his family. Their Brady Bunch family of seven children, along with three grandkids, gathers for family dinners on Mondays. These visits encapsulate the essence of shared values and a commitment to open dialogue.

**Prefer to donate via mail? Address a check to:**

P.O. Box 581557
Salt Lake City, UT 84158

# [#]
Kamala called me...

Picture this:

It’s December 2020. I had just been appointed to Chair the Congressional Hispanic Caucus, where I proudly advocated on behalf of our Hispanic communities, both in CA-25 and across the country.

It was the honor of a lifetime. It would’ve been the perfect day. Unfortunately, Covid-19 had different plans.

While members were preparing for the new year, I sat in quarantine, patiently waiting for my doctor to say I was ready to jump back in the fight for my district. I sure was ready, to say the least — and I always will be!

That’s when I got a call from none other than Vice President Elect Kamala Harris, who heard of my situation and reached out to congratulate me on being Chair and discuss the great work we had planned for the weeks to come!

But that was 2020. It’s 2024, and there’s still work to do — be it defending reproductive rights, securing our democracy, or building an economy that uplifts working people — and it’s never been more important that we’re uniting behind our shared vision of progress.

Before my upcoming end-of-quarter fundraising deadline on Monday — the last one before Election Day — I’m asking for your support. Will you chip in $ to send Kamala Harris to the White House with a Congress who’s ready to get to work? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ruiz-em-fr-sep24?amount=]

Thank you,
Raul

### _WFP’s Sue Altman is Ready to Flip NJ-7!_
On Tuesday, WFP and our allies announced an independent expenditure to back **Sue Altman** , a four-year leader of the New Jersey Working Families Party, in one of the biggest House races of the year. Sue is taking on incumbent Tom Kean Jr., a MAGA Republican who has opposed abortion rights, violated the STOCK Act, and consistently votes against WFP priorities like paid sick days. A former basketball player, a teacher and a coach, who stepped into the role of community activist, Sue raised over $3 million through June and is running a strong campaign. To help her efforts, a coalition — including WFP and several unions — **[has pledged over $500,000](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.nTQp_FEIcSHl649vCJCicr4DqVlLHWSYtxNzpHQ0xObeXn9nFoxFDF2kxwUgfYx82woNvD02ZLQl_i7KPpc5O4RGTmwxj2zBxIRqoCxJ-DO1QfLkEoK733Wagdwqb1g2YagjF3MCelriVvwK0-Bex7NsB3Nvx5Z_tjy0ehOpPxf3Ao3e7ny1W201LGciAUpt5Hmka5PfU_ptB_O9ub5m0YFjwwK3ACPIWYVPVy7Tnx8UkIUu0vh-E0zGYUavjVDh1loH0uN-cDKVgPHnuyIUcgVdeLxFbmggQdf8XlHpacDKX0drOeyhIE-0mVkgB1NlaPuxymTVSNPHXS1UGRAAp2XhT9oj5-of-p6S66d_eA7eUx1_wM5Z3jD4N9avo3KI/4a5/eXQHJBbtTg6kJpPicnq5Uw/h6/h001.geeCtKMyuvEQfGzW6KtzyYsUdfrOXygW74_AoRFNFR8)** for digital ads and mail to rally support. ### **_Going BIG in One of the Biggest Swing States in the Country_**
In 2023, we knocked on nearly 400,000 doors in Pennsylvania, making it one of our biggest organizing drives ever and leading to one of the largest off-year turnouts in years. But guess what? In 2024, we’re going even BIGGER! **Earlier this month, we announced plans to hit over 500,000 doors and send 2 million texts and calls to voters all across the state.** Pennsylvania is absolutely critical for defeating Trump and keeping our Senate majority. But we’re not just backing Vice President Harris and Governor Walz — we’re rallying for Senator Bob Casey, Malcolm Kenyatta for Auditor General, Eugene DePasquale for Attorney General, Squad Rep. Summer Lee, and other key downballot candidates. As Salaah Muhammad, our Pennsylvania Organizing Director, put it, "The most effective way to sway undecided voters is through honest, one-on-one conversations." **[Make a donation to our nationwide voter turnout project today.](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9YOvHCUm3hwQ7DdUDT6vwrRchxYFgulgqVk0EGIhL6Bu2MSgGnG_4aYIaXrTgvMXJ4oK1_9bizAhRV1Ut-_dBsYUg697xDI7_3YzcEJ9EUuOY6enKtzj8URy96QCjojBlirw9K5yi_9dDFIEbeqOiZyW8lpGy_KNQ-mRLI-btjLzxTSTrkh8fCOfwh-YteIKxo8eq47nuO9KbhBrFrQJKkdiZgKtTPYfkaCzPEt2HScZqeAwzU5fzcDEsxr8oHTkzOxsFfU7Y11BXfjfOw6lNqa2okYbE3HND6Y7KEqxxT1tAnJ_jG5nth2UhRLDfbzoCES2djKmtlmSnj9JQs_QfjA/4a5/eXQHJBbtTg6kJpPicnq5Uw/h8/h001.p-Mom4mZ_ITJDahWxT4CqW2W4StbS91jd0H0KUzYKrI)**

### **_Primary Season Is Over_**
With primary season officially over — and the general election less than 6 weeks away — we’d like to highlight some of our recent primary results: **In Delaware** , WFP candidate **Kamela Smith** made headlines by defeating the sitting Speaker of the Delaware House, signaling a potential shift away from the long-dominant “Delaware Way” of pro-corporate politics. NPR affiliate [**WHYY called it the “biggest upset” of the year**](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.XaF8mXqsA6b2dSPmhsleMYzK2-5iJ7nvq8G1pY4EIhJ-Tprbe5eQPwaQIvoSIkBGjvm8CX-oO7LUg9exq1ObOwXCUxFtnagd2kMn16VD1LP99cgvvLgJLgirLj7bkGL_fH-dLyz5HmWtkCycK1L8A5fwnk5UKbKkQn2kgFedsBidToG0wDMRH-gwam_pxrCxq-8Mzt7T5ECXDheGKG0vqnQdL-aIn4MbSlV5R_rNq2FOj4T683gZ4kuU3rSnlF3hWhazHhCsNoT-eTAsuLPHAHGpiN-SgV8R-EEfoaSBySNovQtClay2qp6QiNnZzGxrolmORQRp5obHMUuCSZ9jyv2nYm36uDXRrYET6H_kbe4/4a5/eXQHJBbtTg6kJpPicnq5Uw/h9/h001.L4SAGmUAd9I5jZGb2HyX5xGDFjEI__xPJOJzOiUoyb4), reflecting voters' demand for a working families agenda. Meanwhile, despite a $100k spent against WFP incumbents **Rep. Eric Morrison** and **Councilwoman Shané Darby** , both won their races by double-digit margins. **In Rhode Island** , we went all out to back our WFP champions in the legislature. WFP Reps. **Cherie Cruz** and **Brandon Potter** faced down big-money attacks, but voters saw right through it. They sided with our candidates and their proven record of fighting for affordable healthcare and tenants' rights. Cruz and Potter didn't just win — they crushed it by 20 and 50 points respectively! In addition, WFP up-and-comer **Kelsey Coletta** toppled a conservative incumbent by just 28 votes. **In Minnesota,** **Rep. Ilhan Omar** won her primary, securing support in the 5th Congressional District despite right-wing attacks. She has brought millions to her community, fought for affordable housing, and called for an end to military aid to Israel, marking a setback for Republican megadonors targeting the Squad.
**In Michigan** , we successfully defended three WFP-endorsed incumbents — **Mai Xiong** , **Dylan Wegela** , and**Jenn Hill** — against well-funded challengers. While we fell short of adding another WFPer, our work will be crucial for mobilizing voters in November. **In Washington,** we zeroed in on three key primaries and came out on top in all of them! **Molly Marshall** is leading against the incumbent for Spokane County Council, while WFP champions **Shaun Scott** and **Alexis Merdeces-Rink** are positioned to gain a legislative seat and a city council seat, respectively, in November. **In Wisconsin** , three WFP champions, including **State Rep.** **Ryan Clancy** , secured their primaries. Our members also defeated two Republican ballot measures that threatened state support during crises. However, WFP member **Joe Maldonado** narrowly lost his State House race by less than 2%, but retained his Fitchburg City Council seat, where WFP will hold a majority. In **Arizona** and **Connecticut** , two WFP candidates faced nail-biting races that ended in recounts. **Raquel Teran** in Arizona's 3rd Congressional District lost by just 39 votes, while **Laurie Sweet** in Connecticut's 91st Congressional District initially trailed by 2 votes but won by 15 after the recount. Looking ahead, it’s clear that the upcoming general election could come down to a handful of votes in many states — **and we need to start mobilizing voters now to ensure our movement comes out on top.** [**Donate to WFP’s General Election Fund now so we can block fascism and authoritarianism and continue building multiracial political power that puts working families first this November.**](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfquqxZ_WMtWQ5nsYnjR236T9YOvHCUm3hwQ7DdUDT6vwrRchxYFgulgqVk0EGIhL6Bu2MSgGnG_4aYIaXrTgvMXJ4oK1_9bizAhRV1Ut-_dBsSEZjAgKOyWD73yk0wd30QDx2pxlTdmN9UeicCfetAZcqHX9OC1IMUB-_Wn2Cq7PxJSux9APilkLu16_SO9nwfivD9pfWWIM7OdF7gJ9Mr6oavgkrs8qcob7IS4-S8WigtFp2SeZNIv9HMENr7aHGGOdMqFWiv3TCkKp77idcxLg-liHi9G5HpRFMYUqXJOTTi-LPC8ARgfkUgrOo3sBkJ6Svi5ov-tmfHqOUfkMPffyktkZp8VYiTOtntkE04AqBg/4a5/eXQHJBbtTg6kJpPicnq5Uw/h10/h001.fisxiSL-c4VZIf6KAZMXmbRFTPe9CWP3vRut3BSiyoA)

We're thrilled to announce that WFP has been busy endorsing HUNDREDS of new candidates across the country as we gear up for the November general election!
