clean_body: | | | Peter, In an important election year like this one, time always seems to fly by once we pass Labor Day — and this year is no different! With just 38 days until Election Day, our September newsletter is packed with updates to keep you in the loop. Let’s dive in! WFP’s Research on Working-Class Voters Makes Headlines For over a year, we’ve been working hand in hand with our sibling organization, Working Families Power, to discover how to win and engage working-class voters now and into the future. This month, NBC News published an that shares some of what we’ve learned. We’ve found that the working class isn’t a monolith. It’s our friends, family, and neighbors, with all kinds of jobs, ideologies, ages, and education levels. And after over a year of conversations with thousands of working-class people to understand the nuances and competing perspectives of these voters — we’ve taken what we’ve learned and come up with a road map to build relationships with and persuade these voters to turn out for candidates who will fight for them. Want to dive deeper? Fresh WFP Gear Now Available This month, we dropped some exciting new WFP merch! Now you can look great, show your party pride, and help defeat Trump all at once. now to check out our newly-released Working Families Party for Harris/Walz gear, including lawn signs, window signs, totes, and hats. WFP’s Sue Altman is Ready to Flip NJ-7! On Tuesday, WFP and our allies announced an independent expenditure to back Sue Altman , a four-year leader of the New Jersey Working Families Party, in one of the biggest House races of the year. Sue is taking on incumbent Tom Kean Jr., a MAGA Republican who has opposed abortion rights, violated the STOCK Act, and consistently votes against WFP priorities like paid sick days. A former basketball player, a teacher and a coach, who stepped into the role of community activist, Sue raised over $3 million through June and is running a strong campaign. To help her efforts, a coalition — including WFP and several unions — for digital ads and mail to rally support. So, if you’re in New Jersey’s 7th Congressional District, keep an eye out for an over Kean’s hometown that reads: “Kean & Trump...Perfect Together...Wrong For New Jersey!” Going BIG in One of the Biggest Swing States in the Country In 2023, we knocked on nearly 400,000 doors in Pennsylvania, making it one of our biggest organizing drives ever and leading to one of the largest off-year turnouts in years. But guess what? In 2024, we’re going even BIGGER! Earlier this month, we announced plans to hit over 500,000 doors and send 2 million texts and calls to voters all across the state. Pennsylvania is absolutely critical for defeating Trump and keeping our Senate majority. But we’re not just backing Vice President Harris and Governor Walz — we’re rallying for Senator Bob Casey, Malcolm Kenyatta for Auditor General, Eugene DePasquale for Attorney General, Squad Rep. Summer Lee, and other key downballot candidates. As Salaah Muhammad, our Pennsylvania Organizing Director, put it, "The most effective way to sway undecided voters is through honest, one-on-one conversations." Primary Season Is Over With primary season officially over — and the general election less than 6 weeks away — we’d like to highlight some of our recent primary results: In Delaware , WFP candidate Kamela Smith made headlines by defeating the sitting Speaker of the Delaware House, signaling a potential shift away from the long-dominant “Delaware Way” of pro-corporate politics. NPR affiliate , reflecting voters' demand for a working families agenda. Meanwhile, despite a $100k spent against WFP incumbents Rep. Eric Morrison and Councilwoman Shané Darby , both won their races by double-digit margins. In Rhode Island , we went all out to back our WFP champions in the legislature. WFP Reps. Cherie Cruz and Brandon Potter faced down big-money attacks, but voters saw right through it. They sided with our candidates and their proven record of fighting for affordable healthcare and tenants' rights. Cruz and Potter didn't just win — they crushed it by 20 and 50 points respectively! In addition, WFP up-and-comer Kelsey Coletta toppled a conservative incumbent by just 28 votes. In Minnesota, Rep. Ilhan Omar won her primary, securing support in the 5th Congressional District despite right-wing attacks. She has brought millions to her community, fought for affordable housing, and called for an end to military aid to Israel, marking a setback for Republican megadonors targeting the Squad. In Michigan , we successfully defended three WFP-endorsed incumbents — Mai Xiong , Dylan Wegela , andJenn Hill — against well-funded challengers. While we fell short of adding another WFPer, our work will be crucial for mobilizing voters in November. In Washington, we zeroed in on three key primaries and came out on top in all of them! Molly Marshall is leading against the incumbent for Spokane County Council, while WFP champions Shaun Scott and Alexis Merdeces-Rink are positioned to gain a legislative seat and a city council seat, respectively, in November. In Wisconsin , three WFP champions, including State Rep. Ryan Clancy , secured their primaries. Our members also defeated two Republican ballot measures that threatened state support during crises. However, WFP member Joe Maldonado narrowly lost his State House race by less than 2%, but retained his Fitchburg City Council seat, where WFP will hold a majority. In Arizona and Connecticut , two WFP candidates faced nail-biting races that ended in recounts. Raquel Teran in Arizona's 3rd Congressional District lost by just 39 votes, while Laurie Sweet in Connecticut's 91st Congressional District initially trailed by 2 votes but won by 15 after the recount. Looking ahead, it’s clear that the upcoming general election could come down to a handful of votes in many states — and we need to start mobilizing voters now to ensure our movement comes out on top. Hundreds of New Endorsements Ahead of November! We're thrilled to announce that WFP has been busy endorsing HUNDREDS of new candidates across the country as we gear up for the November general election! From local races to critical congressional seats, our endorsed candidates are ready to take action and make a difference. Want to know who we’re backing and if they’re on your ballot? Upcoming Events Join us this Sunday, September 29, at 7:00 PM ET/ 4:00 PM PT for a virtual Postcard Workshop! In just a few minutes, you can help turn out dozens of voters for November’s historic elections — all you need is your phone, a free app, and your favorite photo! Our organizers will show you how to create personalized Selfie Postcards for friends and family, reminding them to vote for Kamala Harris, Tim Walz, and crucial races down the ballot. We’ll handle all printing and mailing to ensure your postcards arrive by Election Day. Can’t make it? No worries! Join us every Tuesday from now until Election Day at 6:00 PM ET / 3:00 PM PT for our WFP virtual text party! Help support our candidates as our organizers and volunteer leaders guide you through our easy program to text voters on behalf of WFP champions in swing states across the country. On Wednesday, October 16th at 8:00 PM ET/5:00 PM PT, join us again for a Making Meaning of the Moment Mass Call, where WFP National Director Maurice Mitchell, Ash-Lee Woodard Henderson, Abbas Alawieh, and Layla Elabed will be talking about recent updates in American politics, as well as the concrete actions we can take to block the far-right and build working class power. The next WFP Welcome Gathering is on Thursday, October 24th at 7:00 PM ET/4:00 PM PT. Whether this is your first welcome gathering or you come every month, we invite you to join us to hear from WFP staff, members, and activists about our vision for a country that works for the many, not the few. Thanks for reading our WFP newsletter, Peter! We know that was a lot to cover, and it highlights the important work ahead as we approach critical elections at every level — federal, state, and local. With just 38 days until Election Day, every effort counts, and we need your support now more than ever. In solidarity, Team WFP Thoughts? Feedback? We want to hear it. [I’m writing because I want you to split $10 or whatever you can (or more than you can) between Blue Amp Action and my friend Josh Riley to help him win one of the most important races in the country in 2024.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td1cfd220-bdcc-45ba-875d-02e9e072fcd1/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Josh is running for Congress in New York’s 19th District, a key district to taking back the House. Here’s why I support Josh — and why you should too! Josh knows policy issues backward and forward. Together Josh and I did good stuff when he was my counsel on the U.S. Senate Judiciary Committee – good stuff like protecting victims of domestic violence. In the Violence Against Women Act, Josh and I wrote a provision that protected survivors of domestic violence from homelessness. And Josh and I got that protection through a divided Senate, a Republican House, and signed into law. Republicans lie and say Josh was bad on crime, but here’s the truth. Josh and I advanced legislation that funded the police! Providing bullet-proof vests for local and state police. And funding crisis intervention training to teach police officers how to de-escalate situations. Together in the Senate, we also made a lot of Republican witnesses look very bad at hearings when we cross-examined them. Josh really, really cares about all the stuff I care about. And he is the hardest worker I know. And finally, NY-19 is considered a tossup and one of the most competitive in the nation. [So, what do you say? Will you join me by splitting a contribution between Blue Amp Action and Josh’s campaign today?](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tf2cb1589-0954-47db-89f5-6fb11548bffd/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

Hi Derek —
It’s Lexi, Adam’s daughter.

While you might think of him as Congressman, Representative, or just Adam
— to me, he’s just Dad. While you might watch my dad on the news or see a
clip of him in a House Committee, I know him from sitting at the dining
table, watching movies together, or discussing the day’s events.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=sept2024_abs_em.p0j6ot&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOQ_AC90_20240928_PM1_V1_S1&t=1004&akid=7716%2E5257348%2EpIahrb ]Adam posing with his daughter Lexi when she was a baby

Here’s the thing,
Derek: after all these years, he
hasn’t changed.

Not after he was elected to Congress.

Not after managing Trump’s impeachment, being kicked off his committee, or
being censured by MAGA House Republicans for standing up to Trump.

Not after running in an incredibly competitive primary election for Senate
and taking on a celebrity GOP opponent in the general election.

He’s the same guy he’s always been, having the same types of conversations
about our democracy, our ideals, and our values that we’ve had around the
dinner table for the last 20 years.

Running for office is a big task. But it's always been clear to me why my
dad does it. He wants to make a difference in our country and make the
world a better place to live in.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2907?c0=sept2024_abs_em.a1Ivk6&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOQ_AC90_20240928_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1005&akid=7716%2E5257348%2EpIahrb ]My dad’s team sends these emails (and texts) because his campaign

body:
Please let me explain.
#
Hey Peter, it’s Lucas Kunce.
I want to take some time today to tell you a little more about the campaign we’re building to defeat Josh Hawley here in Missouri — and why it’s already the boldest grassroots movement our state has ever seen.
**Will you please let me explain?**
**[CHIP IN NOW](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/74144?refcode=em20240928-7834&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7834%2E614464%2EYISz4S)**
For decades, lying politicians have let massive corporations strip our communities for parts — and Missouri has had a front row seat.
I can’t accept a status quo where politicians who take massive donations from Big Ag tell us it’s normal for billionaires in China and Brazil to buy up our farmland and put hard-working family farmers out of business. I refuse to stand by and watch members of Congress who’ve never worn a uniform sacrifice American lives and tax dollars on forever wars, while refusing to invest in the everyday people who make our country strong.
Out-of-touch elites like Josh Hawley have spent decades wasting our money on tax breaks and subsidies for Wall Street, Big Pharma, Big Tech, and just about everything else that’s gutting our country.
They’re willing to lie, cheat, and steal from the American people to protect the corporate PACs and mega-donors who own their careers. And they’ll even raise their fist to look strong before they start running from threats to our democracy.
**We don’t need any more frauds in Congress.** That’s why I’m running for U.S. Senate. It’s why I’m not taking a single cent from corporate PACs. [**And it’s why today, I’m asking you to make your first donation of $10 or whatever you think is best toward my campaign. Can I count on you to help us stay on track to hit our LAST end-of-quarter fundraising goal, defeat Josh Hawley, and take this seat back for working people?**](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/74144?refcode=em20240928-7834&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=7834%2E614464%2EYISz4S)

Our mission of taking power back for everyday people has earned our movement national media attention. And our commitment to running this campaign the right way, without a cent from corporate PACs, has given us the ability to run the boldest campaign in Missouri history — taking on corrupt political elites like Hawley without hesitation about some mega-donor being upset.
More than just fighting to codify protections for abortion access — **I’m running to end the filibuster so we can actually get it done.**
More than just banning insider trading among members of Congress and their families — **I’m running to put them in jail if they steal from us.**
More than just breaking up Big Pharma — **I’m running to prosecute the insulin cartels who are killing people.**
And more than just rejecting corporate PAC money — **I’m running to abolish corporate PACs altogether.**
**This campaign is powered by the people because that’s exactly who I’ll work for in the U.S. Senate** — I'll be accountable to real, everyday Americans, not some corporate executive or political machine. We’re throwing out their rulebook and building a grassroots movement to fundamentally change who has power in our country. **And I want you to join our team:**
[**So if you’re ready to help us take back power for everyday people in Missouri and across the country, please add a donation of $10 or whatever you can toward my campaign today.**](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/74144?refcode=em20240928-7834&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=10&akid=7834%2E614464%2EYISz4S)
**[ADD A DONATION](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/74144?refcode=em20240928-7834&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=11&akid=7834%2E614464%2EYISz4S)**
For too long, our country’s corrupt politicians have bought their way into power and maintained a broken status quo. That cycle ends with our movement.
Thanks for being part of it,
Lucas Kunce

Bernie was born in Bogota, Colombia. At age five, his American Dream began when he moved to the United States with his family. Bernie became an American citizen at age 18.

Through his relentless work ethic and untamable entrepreneurial spirit, he turned the first car dealership that he purchased in 2005 into one of the largest dealership groups in America.

In 2016, Bernie recognized the value and transformational potential of blockchain technology, before it received mainstream attention, and moved much of his volunteer time and investment dollars into the space. In 2018 he co-founded ChampTitles, which grew to be quite successful as Bernie served as Chairman of the Board.

After a long, successful career, Bernie sold most of his business to begin focusing on his calling: protecting the American dream for another generation.

Solving our country’s problems requires common sense. In Washington, Bernie will fight to shrink government, protect our freedoms, stop the Chinese Communist party from taking our data and land, and always put America First.

Ohioans are done with politicians who talk a big game and do nothing. Bernie wants to go to D.C. to get work done – just like he always has.

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

This is the LAST major reporting deadline before Election Day, and we’re on the verge of overtaking Heinrich in the polls. However, we’re in danger of falling short if we don’t get your support today. These final undecided voters will determine if we win, and hitting this goal is critical. Thank you! Nella Domenici Republican for Senate | ABOUT NELLA New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years. Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant. Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans. Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. body:
https://www.perelesformissouri.com/ [https://www.perelesformissouri.com/]
Peter,
Hurricane Helene has recently caused devastation across much of the South, from Florida and North Carolina to Tennessee.
The images we see of the wreckage caused by widespread flash flooding, mudslides, and damaging wind in the hurricane's wake are heartbreaking. Entire towns have been destroyed. People's homes washed away. Lives have been lost.
As an active member of the American Red Cross for over 38 years, I know firsthand that we can all make an impact and lend a hand to those who may have lost everything .
If you can, please consider sending some support to the American Red Cross' rescue and recovery efforts to help those affected by Hurricane Helene. Anything we can do, big or small, will help those who need us now more than ever.
Please visit www.redcross.org [http://www.redcross.org] to learn more about their disaster relief efforts, volunteer if you are able, or donate. You can donate directly at the following link: https://www.redcross.org/donate/dr/hurricane-helene.html/ [https://www.redcross.org/donate/dr/hurricane-helene.html/] . Or you can text the word REDCROSS to 90999 to make a donation.
Thank you for doing everything you can to help others in need.
Yours in Service,
Joe Pereles

In August, we raised $711,908 online from 25,012 contributions (thank you!!) — at an average contribution of $28. In September, we’ve only received about 19,000 online donations — but our average contribution is up to $31, so we still have a shot at reaching our ambitious goal.

—Tim Kaine

**Nella Domenici**

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years. Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant. Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans. I know this is the kind of politics of division and distraction we’ll see from some in Congress.

Selling campaign merchandise is nothing new. In the 1970s, Gerald Ford sold personalized leather helmets to remind his supporters that he was once a football standout at the University of Michigan.
But here’s the thing, Peter – none of Trump’s merchandise sales are going to his campaign, instead, it will go to him and his family.

Punchbowl News reported this week that Trump has yet to appear at a major fundraising event for the National Republican Congressional Committee, which works to elect Republicans to the House.
Meanwhile, the Republican National Committee, now controlled by Trump’s family and other MAGA diehards, hasn’t given any money to the NRCC this cycle. Trump hasn’t given them anything, either.
This shouldn’t come as a big surprise. Trump’s campaign is solely about furthering his interests and keeping himself out of jail. Well before he rose to the highest office, Trump was known as a con man and a scam artist in his business dealings.

clean_body: Trump isn’t even pretending his latest scam goes to fund his campaign Peter, Yesterday, Donald Trump announced the release of his new line of watches, including one for the insane price of $100,000. You may have noticed that Trump has spent his 2024 presidential run selling Trump and MAGA branded sneakers, cologne, cryptocurrency, trading cards, and even bibles. Selling campaign merchandise is nothing new. In the 1970s, Gerald Ford sold personalized leather helmets to remind his supporters that he was once a football standout at the University of Michigan. But here’s the thing, Peter – none of Trump’s merchandise sales are going to his campaign, instead, it will go to him and his family. = Rather than an entity to, you know, help him or Republicans win political races, Trump’s campaign exists largely as a way for the former president to make himself even richer and pay off his massive legal debts. Unlike Kamala Harris and Joe Biden whose campaigns have given tens of millions to help down-ballot Democrats, Trump has done next to nothing for Republicans this fall. Punchbowl News reported this week that Trump has yet to appear at a major fundraising event for the National Republican Congressional Committee, which works to elect Republicans to the House. Meanwhile, the Republican National Committee, now controlled by Trump’s family and other MAGA diehards, hasn’t given any money to the NRCC this cycle. Trump hasn’t given them anything, either. This shouldn’t come as a big surprise. Trump’s campaign is solely about furthering his interests and keeping himself out of jail. Well before he rose to the highest office, Trump was known as a con man and a scam artist in his business dealings. I believe our government should serve everyday people, not just the rich and powerful.

That’s why I’m proudly running to replace Kevin Cramer in the U.S. Senate.

But I’ll be blunt, Peter:

Before I kicked off this race, I never imagined just how much money it takes to run a campaign – especially against a career politician bankrolled by special interests.

[**_I need to raise $10,000 before the final End of Quarter Deadline to keep my ads on the air and compete with Cramer’s corporate donors. It’s a steep ask – but I know if grassroots Democrats band together, we can pull this off. That’s why I’m asking you personally: Will you chip in $15 before my final End of Quarter Deadline to flip this seat blue? >>_**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93802115/501658220/-1408912288?amount=15&refcode=20240928_em_fr_b1_katrina_main_v1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg4ODgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMmYwMGFkZjEtY2Q3ZC1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=DZP2EjGueRCyrznZRshBXiq--gQShs5MJ3t9iunxU9k=)

I watched my family lose its farm growing up.

I watched my grandmother skip her medication to pay for groceries.

I watched my parents rely on food stamps to put dinner on the table. Look Peter, I know my story isn’t unique. Every single day families are facing the same tough choices mine did. But unlike Kevin Cramer, I vow to always be a leader who fights for the people. [**_That’s why I refuse to take a dime of Corporate PAC money because I want to work for you, not special interests. Every donation means so much to me – and makes all the difference for my campaign. Will you chip in $15 before my final End of Quarter Deadline and help me reach the $10,000 I need? >>_**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93802117/501658221/-1408912288?amount=15&refcode=20240928_em_fr_b1_katrina_main_v1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg4ODgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMmYwMGFkZjEtY2Q3ZC1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=DZP2EjGueRCyrznZRshBXiq--gQShs5MJ3t9iunxU9k=) Peter, it’s obvious my Republican opponent and I are a bit different. He’s Donald Trump’s hand-picked candidate whose campaign is funded by special interests, not hard-working folks. I know I can defeat him – my latest polls show that once voters learn about Cramer’s horrible record for working people, I lead this race by four points.

[**But I’m still being outspent, and I have less than six weeks to make sure every voter in this state hears my message.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/93802119/501658223/-1408912288?amount=15&refcode=20240928_em_fr_b1_katrina_main_v1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg4ODgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMmYwMGFkZjEtY2Q3ZC1lZjExLTg0NzQtNjA0NWJkYThhYWU5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=DZP2EjGueRCyrznZRshBXiq--gQShs5MJ3t9iunxU9k=)

body:
We need to make this an earthquake election that Democrats never forget | | |
---
The main reason Democrats pushed Joe Biden out of the race for president was not to win the White House. **It was actually done to save vulnerable Democrats running down the ballot.** The thinking was that even if Kamala Harris or another replacement could not defeat Donald Trump, they could at least make it close enough to save Democrats like **Jon Tester** in Montana, **Sherrod Brown** in Ohio, **Tammy Baldwin** in Wisconsin, and **Jacky Rosen** in Nevada. Hey friend,
As we’re getting ready to welcome Vice President Harris to Nevada, I want to take a moment to step back and talk about the moment we find ourselves in.
**By November 5, Nevadans will decide.**
_Nevada voters hold the key to everything:_ from control of the House and Senate, to the next White House administration, to the future of abortion, IVF, and birth control access in this country.
What goes on at the top of the ticket is important but so are the choices towards the bottom — local positions and measures that have _major_ impacts on the day-to-day of our lives.
**When I ran to be your NV Dems Chair and won, I was clear about my objective. This party has to be about the community — that means our support and our impact goes beyond the rise and fall of election cycles.**
Joe Lombardo is hand picking GOP candidates that will serve his agenda: putting corporate interests over Nevadans, from vetoing guaranteed school meals to opposing public school funding, endorsing election deniers, touting one of the highest eviction rates in the country, and more. _Even worse, Lombardo has the support of far-right megadonors to back him up._
When the team and I send messages like this asking for money, we’re not asking for your charity. We’re asking for your investment.
We have our work cut out for us over the next few weeks and then we'll get right back to work after November 5. Our job is to deliver the much-needed win that all Americans are counting on us to clinch _and_ to grow our ranks so the voters know who has their best interests in mind all year round.

It's Ken Burns. For nearly 50 years I've shared America's story through documentaries. In that time, I've chronicled some of our nation's great challenges, from wars and depression to conflict at home, but also many of our glories, our effort to preserve world peace, to fight for democracy, to address issues like poverty and inequality and of course our support for art and culture.

subject: This movement is about more than us
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
The challenges we’re facing are real.
#
Hey there! It’s the Squad, and we wanted to personally check in with you.
In a time when our Squad is being targeted like never before, we’re more committed than ever to standing up for justice, equity, and our communities.
The challenges we’re facing are real. In the last primary election, we lost a number of bold and outspoken progressive leaders to insidious moderate campaigns with big funders in their back pockets.
[But, when our grassroots community stands with us, we are unstoppable. Will you stand with us and chip in $4 - $1 per campaign - to boost our Squad’s resources ahead of the end of the quarter?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240928-svf.CP9hWD&refcode=em20240928-7291-P_FND_SVF_SVF&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7291%2E2526796%2EolMlgb)
**[Contribute $4](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240928-svf.CP9hWD&refcode=em20240928-7291-P_FND_SVF_SVF&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=7291%2E2526796%2EolMlgb)**
Every one of our Squad members has a role in advancing life-changing policies in Congress while boldly calling out injustice and inequity in our government. **And our deep-pocketed opponents have made it clear that they don’t want us in office because we don’t back down – not now, not ever.**
We’ve grown so much since our Squad first got to Congress in 2018 — and yet our conviction has never wavered — to show up as true representatives of our communities, to inform policy rooted in justice and equity, and to lead with compassion.
**Our opponents fail to realize that this movement is about more than us Congressmembers. And as long as we have your support and faith in this movement, our Squad will always win.**
[Will you chip in to ensure your Squad has the resources to keep up our collective fight? Your contribution sends a powerful message that you won’t be silenced.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240928-svf.CP9hWD&refcode=em20240928-7291-P_FND_SVF_SVF&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=7291%2E2526796%2EolMlgb)
Thank you for being in this fight with us,
Squad Victory 2024

body:

| |

---
| | | My fellow Americans - this is Michael Whatley.

When I was elected Chairman of the Republican National Committee, I made a promise to the American People that I'd leave it all on the field to help Conservatives win. I made that same promise to President Trump. _And I intend on keeping that promise if it 's the last thing I do._

**_[Unfortunately, that sometimes comes with the responsibility to deliver tough news. And here we are:](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/YAVY3OsedIFU_pD6Yr0fRg~~/AARclAA~~ "Unfortunately, that comes with the responsibility to deliver tough news to hear. ")_**

We're facing major headwinds in our fight to save our Conservative House Majority, retake the Senate, and send the greatest President of my lifetime - Donald J. Trump - back to the White House...
* House Democrats have _90+ million dollars_ sitting in the bank
* Senate Democrats have raised _150 million dollars_ to date
* Kamala Harris bragged about raking in _500 million dollars_ to win
* She cut a _25 million dollar_ check to crush down-ballot Conservatives
* Liberals have raised over _1 billion dollars_ online this cycle

My heart sank when I saw these numbers. That's why I'm sending you this email as fast as I can. **_[I'm teaming up with Majority Leader Steve Scalise ONE LAST TIME to raise three million dollars before the final End-of-Quarter deadline of the election.](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/YAVY3OsedIFU_pD6Yr0fRg~~/AARclAA~~ "I’m teaming up with Majority Leader Steve Scalise ONE LAST TIME to raise three million dollars before the final End-of-Quarter/Month deadline of the election.")_**

subject: [GOTV UPDATE] Nearly 1 million doors knocked.

body:
THIS is how we will win in November, Peter...

If you are unable to see the message below, [click here to view](https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTE1Njk4OTES1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjA2MDU0MzIzMgS2&mt=1&rt=0).
| | | |
---
|
* * *
---
| | | | Peter — thanks to support from LCV members like you, LCV Victory Fund is making _huge_ progress as we scale up our largest-ever voter turnout operation, which **will ultimately reach more than one million voters this fall.**
---
| | In the past two weeks, LCV Victory Fund has _doubled_ our voter contacts — that means **we’ve already knocked on** _**nearly 1 million doors**_ in the states and districts that will decide control of the White House and Congress next year.
---
| | Here’s where our campaign stands with just weeks to go until Election Day:
---
| |
* **Nearly 1 million doors knocked across 11 states:** Arizona, California, Michigan, Montana, Nebraska, Nevada, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Pennsylvania, and Wisconsin.
* **Over 22,000 supporters have committed to recruit three friends to vote** in November, _tripling_ the impact of our canvass on Election Day.
* **71% of contacted voters** have committed to support Kamala Harris for president.

---
| | This work is making a difference. Here are just a few anecdotes shared by canvassers in the field, who have been having meaningful, face-to-face conversations with voters across the country:
---
| |
* In **Bozeman, Montana** our state affiliate spoke with a Republican voter who said that they plan to vote for Senator Jon Tester, in part because of his track record of fighting for issues important to Montanans, such as access to public lands.
* In **Madison, Wisconsin** we spoke to a voter who cited fighting climate change as the motivation for his vote. He believes that the Biden-Harris administration has done a lot on this issue, but that supporting Harris-Walz and Senator Tammy Baldwin is necessary to ensure that these gains are maintained and expanded.
* In **Lathrup Village, Michigan** we met with a voter who spoke passionately about Harris’s dedication to justice and equity, as well as Representative (and Senate candidate) Elissa Slotkin’s effective, hands-on approach to problem-solving. They committed to vote in November and to bring three other people to the polls.

---
| | After months of planning, we’re now in a sprint to the finish to elect Kamala Harris to the White House and secure pro-environment, pro-democracy leadership in Congress. We still have a lot of work to do — **but stories like this give me hope that we are on the path to victory, thanks to your support.**
---
| | If you’re able to do even more to support these critical conversations, please [**make a gift to power LCV Victory Fund’s turnout operation and get us closer to our goal of reaching more than a million voters. Right now, a major partner has agreed to match every dollar we spend on the presidential race — that means you can DOUBLE your impact if you give today >>**](https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/3Z0ec-)
---
| | Thanks again for your support, Peter. I’ll be sure to keep you in the loop on our campaigns as we approach Election Day.
---
| | Onward,
---
| | Erin Phillips
National Field Director
LCV Victory Fund

My most important supporters aren’t the ones who make the biggest donations.

More than 325,000 people have contributed to my campaign, and more have taken action to support me. Even things as simple as reading this email help out more than you might think.

**It 's been a busy few weeks on the campaign trail.**
We forced Josh Hawley to debate, and held him accountable for only serving himself in the U.S. Senate. We've withstood millions of dollars in false attack ads from Josh Hawley's campaign and billionaire-funded Super PAC. And now, new polling shows that -- even despite those attacks -- we've managed to cut Hawley's lead to just 4% after introducing my background and message to Missourians on TV.
We've got the MO-mentum we need to win this race. And the big events we've held with hundreds of voters at a time across rural, urban, and suburban Missouri are the surest sign yet.
**The energy I 'm seeing on the ground is real and exciting.** So I wanted to take a moment today to give you a quick look at what I'm seeing all across Missouri:

Team: The Michigan Voting Rights Act is good legislation. This bill:
➜ Guarantees in state law protections previously afforded under the 1965 federal Voting Rights Act.
➜ Establishes a nonpartisan election information database.
➜ Requires some local governments to provide alternate language voting materials.
➜ Allows for curbside voting and other assistive services for disabled voters.
This package of bills will reinforce Michigan’s election system and provide clear pathways for those who feel their voting rights are being infringed to right the wrongs that may have stopped them from voting.
Remember: The recent 8th Federal Circuit Court ruling is one of the most dangerous anti-voter rulings we’ve seen in years . In the eight states impacted by the ruling, voters and voting rights organizations can no longer sue to overturn unjust laws under the Voting Rights Act.
These new laws, if passed in Michigan, would restore those protections and codify them into state law, regardless of how the Supreme Court eventually rules.
Team: We need to pass these bills in Michigan and expand this movement to other states around the country. # Sharon Clahchischilliage Invites President Donald Trump to New Mexico
---
| “Hey Donald Trump,
Sharon Clahchischilliage here. I am a candidate running for U.S. Congress New Mexico District 3. This is an invitation to you to come visit us here in (NM) District 3.
I want you to meet the people who are experiencing the effects of a buffer zone around Chaco Canyon.
I want you to meet the people of Mora County who have been left homeless because they have not been compensated from a fire that occurred two years ago in Mora County.
I want you to experience the people, the ranchers, the farmers, who are experiencing land grabs in their area. I need for you to. come here and see what the government is doing to District 3.
You know what? District 3 is rich. We have the Permian Basin. We have the San Juan Basin. Which is a big concern to the global energy world. We fund 50% of the state budget.
So, consider this a very important invitation President Trump. I need your help. I need you to help me show the people that we care. I need you to help me show the people that we CAN do something for them.”

Hi friend, it’s Michael.
Happy National Public Lands Day! I’ll keep this short since I know we’d all rather be outside enjoying the fun and beauty offered by our public lands.
This week, I introduced the GORP Act — and no, it's not about trail mix, as the name might suggest. The GORP Act is my new bill to protect parts of Gunnison Basin and its surrounding areas.
This bill is the product of a decade of collaboration between local governments, Tribes, business owners, and outdoor recreationists. From trailheads to kitchen tables, we worked together to write a bill that would preserve the parts of Colorado we love most for future generations.
In total, the GORP Act will protect over 730,000 acres of Western Colorado.
I’m committed to standing up for Colorado’s public lands in the Senate. Will you support my work by chipping in before our end-of-quarter fundraising deadline in two days? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/embutton?refcode=X_092824_EOQ_GORP_act]

body:
| | | Friend,

The past few years for us have been a whirlwind. From raising our three boys to my Senate campaign in 2020 and my official swearing into Congress, it certainly has gone by quickly. Through the highs and the lows, my team has stuck by me. **I couldn’t be prouder of my co-pilots because they have ALWAYS put our mission before themselves. ** This road hasn’t been easy. We’ve taken on the Democrat establishment for years here in Michigan. I’ve been in some of the closest races in the nation, and when we finally tasted victory in 2022, we showed the world what is possible for the son of parents who grew up in the Jim Crow South. None of it, and I mean none of it, would have been possible without the generosity and support of patriots like you. **I’ve tried to pay your kindness back. From my service as an Apache helicopter pilot in the Army to my commitment to representing the people of Michigan, I’m working on building a better future for our children's generation.** **_I know that by being steadfast in my faith, my beliefs, and my dedication to our country– anything is possible. I know you feel the same way. _** The reality of the situation is that I’m going up against a **$10 MILLION offensive** by National Democrats. I’m going against a socialist opponent who almost took me down last election. The margin of victory is 0.5%. It was **_that close_**. I’ll level with you. As difficult as it is for a veteran like me to ask for help, I need to do so now. With our House majority hanging by a thread and Michigan as the key to the House, the Senate and the Presidency, Democrats are throwing everything they can at me and dragging my name through the mud. _**I’m coming up on the FINAL end-of-quarter deadline of the election in just a few days, and we are experiencing a CRISIS BUDGET SHORTFALL.**_ _**The reality of the situation is that we’re looking at a Democrat strategy that is they will spend whatever it takes to buy this seat. **_ **We need to get our message out to as many Michiganders as we can to even have a shot at winning this. That’s why I’m humbly asking you to join us. ** **[**Will you pitch in to help me get back to Congress?**](http://links.jjforcongress.com/u/click?_t=f784024d18db4d2d88c26e9627b85cc7&_m=e482c240fdbb4ff792f3d8f74abc12a2&_e=TE-m1IQPjJ_4Gd-N5_DQizJnrBUcgtEAKfdzh4Sc8p0nGMdRjhi5BwprRjxH-LfRbFGZlE5_V8LrH2p5XTuDNc6iwNp71Sr4_fB3QNGg-pAhEuGjZrSG0LncgNwMc2BK7wLeFbZ2TURBWgT-OxUU7x00h-P4jhDr2DKrM5Wp-jfXdLbYSmy57fuhqrN0N6tKHcHoMH1EDNSaL2JGImLXmk5HAxNIhS54CsIRWLW4Avtn_RVZraX7CnRaHIaiqlL4Xq3XWh1OPRRz1Gy7jtad0hXhfnqRV0rpXy_8MnSo35feASSAW2UdF_cImfapwAH2EVzs_Qz9maI_YMsa5ON9Zk6LbkBWn86eL3-OsukyUdM%3D)** ****

body:
Join Senator Hunley's VP Debate Watch Party on 10/1 at The Dugout! | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/d0ab93184a1a/youre-invited-vp-debate-watch-party?e=d9ebccf591)
---

---
| **YOU'RE INVITED! ** Our last Debate Watch Party was such a success, we're doing it again. And this time, we'll be at a larger, all-ages venue. We've got the large private event space at The Dugout on Virginia Avenue to gather together, share good food, and participate in democracy. People across the country have started early voting and Gov. Walz is about to take on JD Vance on the debate stage. As an educator, I am excited to watch former teacher and football coach Governor Walz take the debate stage.

He's got our back, so we need to have his. We'll be about 1 month out from Election Day, so it is time to roll up our sleeves, get to work, and talk to more voters. I can't wait to see you there!
**WHEN:** Tuesday, October 1
**WHERE:** The Dugout- 621 Virginia Avenue
---
|
---
| | **LOGISTICS** **The more the merrier, invite friends and neighbors.[ Please RSVP here.](https://coom.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5c2b34b98b419cb5ca0511f25&id=5488447850&e=d9ebccf591)**

**Parking: **Parking is available on the street.

**Attire:** Come as you are. This is also the time to wear your favorite political, union, candidate, USA, and get out the vote swag.

**Food & Drink Details: **We'll have some appetizers to share. You can purchase more and the bar will be open for your business.

**RSVP:[ Click here to RSVP!](https://coom.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5c2b34b98b419cb5ca0511f25&id=c36d4bc3ef&e=d9ebccf591)**
**Volunteer Sign Ups:** We will have information on how you can get involved with campaigns including Hoosiers for Harris and our statewide races.
---
|
---
|
---
|
---
---
| | THANK YOU to all who came out to our last Debate Watch Party. There is something really special about gathering together in community. The energy in the room was electric. I had the chance to see familiar faces and meet new friends, including first time voters!

# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=39143%2E3422442%2EjiFjjf)
Derek,
Scare tactics that pressure folks to donate are not my style. But sometimes, we do need to talk about the gravity of what is at stake— _and that_ is frankly scary.
There is so much on the line this November: abortion rights, cost of living, tax fairness, worker’s rights, health care, climate change, and more. The reality is that as long as members of Congress accept corporate money, they won’t have your interests at the top of their mind.
That’s why my PAC, Truth to Power, is dedicated to uplifting candidates that will put people over corporations—candidates we need in Congress _right now_.
**[Will you donate $5 or anything you can afford today so my PAC can meet our End of Quarter goal?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240928?refcode=em20240928-39143&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=39143_3422442_jiFjjf&akid=39143%2E3422442%2EjiFjjf)**
We need grassroots funding to stand up to special interest groups and corporate greed.
We cannot do this without your support, and we’re still short of our $80,000 end-of-quarter goal, but with a little more help, we can get there before the deadline in two days.
**[Can you pitch in any amount now to help us reach our goal?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240928?refcode=em20240928-39143&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=39143_3422442_jiFjjf&akid=39143%2E3422442%2EjiFjjf)**

Thank you,
Katie Porter

I rely on donations from grassroots supporters like you to hit these goals — not corporate PACs. Thank you for having my back as I lead the fight to protect Social Security and Medicare and ensure that seniors can retire in dignity. Thank you for proudly standing with me in my fight to certify the Equal Rights Amendment. Today, we’re so close to finally establishing gender equality in our Constitution — giving us a legal basis to restore reproductive rights. But here's the bad news: If Republicans flip even one Senate seat, they could retake the majority and undo all of our progress. With 23 Democratic seats on the ballot, our grassroots resources will be stretched thin. body:
Hi, Peter. It's James Carville and Paul Begala.
We know a thing or two about close elections, so take our word when we say we’re _extremely concerned about what we’re seeing in Pennsylvania’s Senate race._
If you don’t believe us, we prepared a brief memo highlighting the key factors of this race for you.
[**If you don’t need convincing, rush a donation to Bob Casey’s campaign now.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240928-6?refcode=em20240928-6&refcode2=4370_552475_0uXa93&akid=4370%2E552475%2E0uXa93)
**[Donate ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240928-6?refcode=em20240928-6&refcode2=4370_552475_0uXa93&akid=4370%2E552475%2E0uXa93)**
**END-OF-QUARTER CAMPAIGN MEMO ON PA-SEN** **FROM:** James Carville and Paul Begala, Senior Democratic Strategists
**TO:** Interested Parties We need to be clear with you about where things stand in this battleground Senate race. **The Senate race in Pennsylvania is in a dead heat.**
* A number of polling agencies and political experts have released figures showing that Bob Casey’s race will be one of the closest on the map.
* Washington Post Poll: Bob Casey 48% – David McCormick 48%
* CNN Poll: Bob Casey 46% – David McCormick 46%
* RealClearPolitics: PA Senate race is a tossup.
* Roll Call: Bob Casey is the 3rd most vulnerable Senator running for re-election.
* The numbers tell some clear signs. This is one of the closest Senate races in the country.

**McCormick and GOP billionaires are spending $150 million to flip this battleground.**
* With less than 6 weeks left until Election Day, this campaign is being outspent by tens of millions and is at risk of being drowned out on the airwaves.
* Keystone Renewal, one of the largest single-candidate super PACs in history, is spending more than $56 million supporting David McCormick. That’s unheard of in Senate races this cycle.
* The Senate Leadership Fund, a Mitch McConnell-linked super PAC, is spending $24 million to defeat Bob Casey.
* We believe David McCormick will continue to self-fund his campaign with millions from his personal fortune, and you can expect more opposition ad spending in the final weeks.
* While Pennsylvanians are being inundated with GOP attack ads, Bob Casey’s campaign might have to go dark if they don’t have the resources to keep up. In a race this close, that could be the difference between winning and losing.

**Pennsylvania has historically been the tipping point for U.S. Elections.**
* We’ve been on both the winning and losing side of elections, and here’s what we know for sure: _As PA goes, so goes the nation._
* In 2016, 44,292 votes in PA propelled Donald Trump to his unexpected win.
* In 2020, Joe Biden clinched Pennsylvania’s 20 electoral votes by a narrow 1.17% margin, helping him secure the White House.
* Nate Silver’s model is predicting that whichever presidential candidate wins PA has over a 93% chance of winning.
* When charting a path to a Democratic Senate majority, **_Pennsylvania is a must-win race._**

**Bob Casey needs the resources to make his case.**
* In order to win, this campaign needs to make the case directly to voters about the threat David McCormick poses to Pennsylvanians' fundamental freedoms -- and that takes organizing and advertising.
* With the final end-of-quarter deadline just 2 days away, Bob Casey needs your help now more than ever. Hitting this fundraising milestone is _extremely important_ to ensure that this campaign is on track for victory.

---
Listen, Peter, after crunching the numbers, one thing is clear: Bob Casey needs your help.
[**So please, if you want to make sure Democrats win the Senate and White House this year, donate $5 or more to Bob’s re-election campaign right now. This may be the most important moment of this cycle.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240928-6?refcode=em20240928-6&refcode2=4370_552475_0uXa93&akid=4370%2E552475%2E0uXa93)

Thank you for your support.
– James Carville and Paul Begala

body:
The best way to support a candidate financially is to donate to their campaigns | | |
---
|
---
If you’re like most conservatives, you get endless emails and text messages from candidates asking for money. _But how do you know if they are actually conservative and not just pretending?_ _How do you know if they even have a chance of winning?_ _How do you know if costly fundraising commissions and processing fees will consume most of your contribution?_ These are all important questions that everyone must ask if they want to be effective with their political contributions. **The Senate Conservatives Fund is one of the best ways to make your contributions count.** We do it by providing grassroots conservatives like you with a trusted list of candidates who are strong, viable conservatives. Every SCF-endorsed candidate must undergo a vetting process to help us determine whether they share our principles and values and, more importantly, will actually fight for them after the election. Every candidate must also run a professional campaign capable of winning. But creating a list of conservative candidates is just the beginning; we also give you an _**[_**effective way to fund their campaigns!**_](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=4715be94a5d14298a46bdb7a9899aa95&_e=lM_qrVwoAASGsPbD57GVYkOVfSqv3AMMfzt3AZAtHqNm9VJ8lVqN_6k6fd2F4DW-Wt7aysany5lJ04lJao38mT7xg43aG0T3EXBDbxCxq89UOSrPqtY8yVoJ-Bj1Xv8x6AbUQSpEBX_buXTFkS9sQ9z3F4LNCVyK_02IhAsN6ST8NXDncw6Y0p7bavsgNZ0El59p3M3tKpiYou47ePXtni8QMQPZlCsQ_DHVT_VbIvw%3D)**_ The best way to support a candidate financially is to donate to their campaigns. Once you move away from the candidate’s campaign — whether it be a party committee, joint-fundraising committee, PAC, or other organization — your contribution's effectiveness declines. However, donating to multiple candidates can be complicated and time-consuming, and there could be hidden fees and expenses that make this less beneficial to the candidates. **That's why SCF allows you to donate to multiple candidates with one payment and why SCF pays all fundraising expenses related to those contributions.** _This saves candidates a ton of money._ As you know, processing fees are charged for all online transactions. What you probably don’t know is that candidates also often pay steep fundraising commissions to third-party vendors, which are at least 80% of the value of your contribution. name: Tamie Wilson
subject: IMPORTANT REMINDER while our Buckeyes take the field...
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
I know everyone in Ohio is watching our Buckeyes storm the field right now and is ready to watch them go 4-0!
WE ARE BUCKEYE NATION.
I’m so proud of these students for playing their hearts out, they’re having a hell of a season and they really do Ohio proud.
These students deserve our unconditional support both on and off the field, and I can’t help but remind everyone of the despicable way that Jim Jordan has failed our state and our country by enabling one horrible abuser after another – starting right here in Ohio.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240928_osu_never_forget_image [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240928_osu_never_forget_image]
As an assistant wrestling coach at OSU, Jordan ignored his students who confided in him that the team doctor was sexually abusing them. They begged him for help, and Jim Jordan did NOTHING.
Years later, when they began to seek justice in the courts, instead of running to their sides and sticking up for them asking what he could do to help... asking if they’re okay, like any innocent and decent human being would do, their former coach, Jim Jordan, called the guys who were scheduled to testify and begged them not to rat him out!
He did NOTHING to help them and he continues to do nothing for them or us, his constituents.
This campaign is the best chance we’ve ever had to end Jim Jordan’s career. Will you give $50, $100, or more tonight to send Jordan home to face the music? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240928_osu_never_forget_link]
TAKE DOWN JIM JORDAN [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240928_osu_never_forget_button1]
I’m honored to have the support of many of the athletes who suffered while Jordan ignored their pleas. I’m committed to helping them get justice and to preventing this from happening to any other student.
In fact, I’ve already authored a bill called The Comprehensive Sexual Abuse Prevention and Accountability Act , and I am already working with Representatives of the House and Senators to get my bill introduced this year.
I am already doing more work than Jordan and I am not even an elected official, YET.
Early voting is just over a week away, so there is no more time to sit back and wait. If you want Jim Jordan out of Congress I need your help right now!
Everyone, dig deep and give as much as you can to get us over the finish line!
Working for US,
Tamie Wilson
